sanskrit: śātamurīkariṣyati cirātkaṃsārivaṃśīravaḥ duritajātaṃ devakīnandano naḥ viditaścakāsti govindo'yamakhaṇḍamaṇḍalayaśaścandrao jagatprāptavān nmugdhasvāntamadhuvrato vijayate sattarkapañcānanaḥ sādhanavidhiḥ saṃkṣepaḥ kathyate pañcānano vijayate bhuvi devanāthaḥ vada ko viśeṣaḥ vinyāsādiviśeṣān yo veda sa kaumudīṃ veda nirmāṇamapi kathyate pañcarātrāpramāṇatvabodhakād bhaṭṭavārtikāt syādaprāmāṇyabodhakam śiṣṭācāro'pi naivātra pramāṇaṃ paridṛśyate kiṃ kimarthaṃ nirūpyate kvacitsaṃvādaśūnyatā kṛtaḥ kiṃ ca vacanādapi siddhyati vedamantrāṇāṃ pañcarātroditovidhiḥ brahmakṣatraviśāṃ caiva pañcarātraṃ vidhīyate brahmapurāṇe'pi carite pauruṣottame vedāntavākyaviṣayāstasmādveda virodhinaḥ pāśupatācārāstathā vai pāñcarātrakāḥ pāśupataṃ somaṃ lakṣmaṇañcaiva cauravam purāṇeṣu nindārthaṃ tatparaṃ ca tat pañcarātrāṇi saptarātrāṇi vai mayā tantramādyaṃ tantrantrailokyamohanam

nāradīyaṃ ca māṇḍavyaṃ śāṇḍilyaṃ raiṇukaṃ tathā svāyambhuvaṃ kāpilaṃ ca tārkṣyaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam tathāṣṭārṇamityuktastasya vistaraḥ budho mantraṃ sadgurorupadeśayet kaṭapottheyavargotthaiḥ piṇḍāntairaṅkamakṣaraiḥ lobhātpaṭuḥ prāyaḥ rudraḥsyātra ruruḥ karam kramāt svarānmautu revatyaṃ sagatau tadā vipat kṣema pratyariḥ sādhako vadhaḥ nāmādyavarṇasya rāśinakṣatraśodhanam tayoḥ prādhānyametayoḥ janmabheṣu guṇasaṃkalane manoḥ janmapadagā nirmūlā lakṣaṇā bhavet cobhayavicārārthaṃ vākyametadbhaviṣyati tathācedaṃ nāmno grāhyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet siddhādyapekṣāpi nāstyatretyavagamyate cetaḥ samādhāya vilokayatu yuktimān janmabhaṃ yasya tasya nāmarkṣamūhayet tvanyathā proktaṃ māntrikairmantravedibhiḥ jñātavyaṃ mantrakovidaiḥ yojitā varṇāḥ kanyāyāṃ śādayaḥ sthitāḥ caturbhiryādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kṣakāro mīnagastviti śāradādau yaḥ pāṭhaṃ paṭhati tāntrikaḥ bhrātṛbandhu putraśatrukalatrakāḥ tatrāviruddho'sya pāṭhaḥ kinnahi paṭhyate vyatyayamātraṃ syāt padayostu padāntaram

nityaṃ dhanaṃ dhanavivṛddhidam putra vivṛddhiḥsyād bandhau bāndhavavatpriyam tathā rudre grahe netre yuge ravau ca śaracandre trayodaśe matimān vidyāt siddhādikaṃ tataḥ mantrādyarṇacatuḥkoṣṭhaparyantaṃ gaṇayed budhaḥ kālena sādhyastu japahomataḥ gaṇayenmantrī nāmakoṣṭhānusārataḥ yathoktena dviguṇāt siddhasādhyakaḥ dviguṇāt sādhyasiddhastu sādhyasādhyo nirarthakaḥ rathātmahā rāśiśuddhiḥsyāda vārāhītantramabravīt dhīmadbhirvaiphalyaṃ yadato'nyathā pratyagāyatāścaivaṃ bhānurekhāḥ prakalpayet ṣaṭsvekamekamālikhya kādihāntaṃ tato'kṣaram digbhūgiriśrutigajarāmarṣiṣvabdhiṣaṭatrikaiḥ indranakṣatranayanaravipañcadaśaturbhiḥ nāmārṇakoṣṭhāṅkamatho ādyāntanihitaṃ kramāt paryavasannāste guṇakāṅkāḥ samāsataḥ tattattu nagabhūbhānunimnagāḥ jñātvobhayor-ṛṇaṃ vidyāt adhikaṃ śeṣamaṅkavit dṛśyeta so'dhamarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ [k: samīritaḥ] tadbhāve samadhanaṃ dhanikaṃ na kadācana varṇamādāya paramaṃ tu [k: paratastu] ye saptabhirguṇanīyāstu haraṇīyāstribhistribhiḥ

mantrasyādimamādāya varṇamanye pare tu ye saṃkhyā guṇanīyāstribhistataḥ kulākulaparīkṣāyāṃ prakāraḥ kathyate'dhunā pañcahrasvāḥ pañcadīrghā bindvantāḥ sandhisambhavāḥ sādhakasyākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ mantrasyāpi yadakṣaram vāruṇaṃ mitramāgneyamapi mārutam āgneyasyāmbhasaṃ śatrurnabhasastaijasaṃ tathā kuryānmelanaṃ budhaḥ bhāni daivāni māntrikāḥ martyāhvayagaṇaḥ prokto bhānyetāni viśāradaiḥ varuṇaḥ kṛttikendrāgnī rakṣogaṇa udāhṛtaḥ rakṣasāṃ vairamucyate mātṛkāvarṇabhedebhyaḥ sarve mantrāḥ prajajñire puṃdevatāmantrāḥ vidyāḥ strīdevatā matāḥ strīsvarūpāśca namo'ntāśca napuṃsakāḥ trividhā mantrā vaśyaśāntyabhicārike mantrā vijñeyāḥ krūrasaumyayoḥ saumyā bhūyiṣṭhendvamṛtākṣarāḥ sthite prāṇe saumyā bodhaṃ prayānti ca phalaṃ sarve prabuddhā mantriṇāṃ sadā savisargāṃstān kṣakāraṃ kevalaṃ paṭhet nṛsiṃhārkavarāhāṇāṃ prāsādapraṇavasya ca striyā datte mālāmantre tathaiva ca tribīje ca śaktirekākṣare manau viṃśatyarṇādhikā mantrā mālāmantrā udīritāḥ

sāpiṇḍākṣaramantrāśca śrī cintāmaṇikādayaḥ pañcākṣarādhikā vānye (bālye)sarvadā siddhidāḥ pare sarvatantrāṇāmanurodhena vacmyaham [k: bravīmyaham] ratnalābhaḥ [k: nāśaḥ] syāt jyeṣṭhe ca maraṇaṃ dhruvam bhādrapade sarvataḥ sukhamāśvine jñānahāniḥ syānmāghe medhāvivardhanam śuklapakṣīyā putravṛddhikarī matā proktā ṣaṣṭhī sarvatra ninditā ṝkthanāśā ca daśamī sukhaśaṃsinī gosamṛddhiḥ syāt trayodaśyāṃ śubhodayaḥ tu balahā pratipadbuddhināśinī ṣaṣṭhī syāditi śaivāgamāntare vāñchitasiddhistu ratnalābhaḥ śubhodayaḥ sarvakāmārthamiti tu proktaṃ śrīmantradarpaṇe mṛgaśiro rohiṇī ca divākaraḥ nityaṃ kanyādyaṃ mīnakāvadhi raṅgasaṃpannaḥ sukhabhojī dhanāśrayaḥ rogaśokākulo nityaṃ kṛttikāyāṃ sadā bhavet bhavellābho nṛpatīṣṭaḥ sabāndhavaḥ prajāvṛddhiḥ kāryārambhe sadāsthitiḥ aśleṣāyāṃ tathā mantrī vināśaṃ yāti nityaśaḥ pūrvatraye'pi saṃpūrṇavedatritayapāragaḥ vidyālābhastathaiva ca mṛtyuvaśaṃ yāti balahānistathā bhavet anurādhāgate candre bhāskarābhaḥ śubhaḥ priyaḥ

mahāmatiḥ prājño bahusantatireva ca dhanāḍhyastu yuvatīlāsakaḥ kṛtīḥ caiva dīrghāyurdhanadhānyasamāśrayaḥ kṛttikāyāṃ ca mantrārambhaḥ praśasyate bhavati vṛṣe rogasamanvitaḥ kavikulārātiḥ kanyāyāṃ phalabhāgbhavet śreyān makare nirdhano ghaṭe susaṃpanne dīkṣāmahani kārayet mahāgurau tu sarvajñe viparīte na yojayet saṃkṣepānmantriṇāṃ hitahetave mananātsarvabhūtānāṃ trāṇāt saṃsārasāgarāt sākṣātkṛtveṣṭadevatām yato dadyāt kuryātpāpakṣayaṃ yataḥ jñānasarvasvaṃ kṣiṇoti pāpapañjaram brāhmaṇāditrayāṇāṃ ca svakarmādhyayanādiṣu ca mantrayantrārcanādiṣu yadṛcchayā śrutaṃ mantraṃ chadmanātha balena vā dīkṣā tatprakāro nigadyate kṛtanityakriyo'nyasmin divase gurusattamaḥ śaṅkhamupādāya taṃ prakṣālya phaḍambunā | mūlena manunā dadyājjalaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ hṛdā śaktergandhāṣṭakaṃ biduḥ viṣṇorgandhāṣṭakaṃ matam kuṣṭhasaṃyuktaṃ śaivaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ matam ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃbhūtā amṭādyā vidhikramāt

bhānostā vahnerdaśakalāstathā daśakalā yādyādyāstāḥ prakīrtitāḥ tāsāṃ nāmnaḥ pūrvamanukramāt bhavet svarabhavā iti ebhiḥ padaiḥ pūjākhilaiḥ kramāt prāṇapratiṣṭhādāveṣa eva vidhirmataḥ prajapenmantraṃ saṃpūjya sthāpayedasūn paṭhenmantraṃ saṃpūjyasthāpayedasūn tryambakaṃ prajapenmantraṃ saṃpūjya sthāpayedasūn tatsaviturjapenmantraṃ saṃpūjya sthāpayedasūn paṭhenmantraṃ saṃpūjya sthāpayedasūn kramato jñeyāḥ ṣoḍaśasvarapūrvikāḥ candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadā ṣoḍaśendukalāḥ proktā bhānumaṇḍalagāḥ kramāt viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā pañcabhedebhyaḥ pañcāśadvarṇagāḥ kalāḥ sthitiḥ siddhiriti proktā daśākārakalāḥ kramāt prītirdīrghā cokārajāḥ kramāt utkārī mṛtyuretāḥ syurmakārātmakalāḥ kramāt svavargasthā nādajāścakalāḥ kramāt dīpikā caiva rocikā mocikā parā vyomarūpāḥ syuranantāḥ svaraśaktayaḥ gāyatrīṃ jātavedo manuṃ tathā kecidvadantyatrāpyupadeśajaḍagrahāt sakārāntān bindubhūṣitamastakān

haṃsaparātmānau tato'muṣyapadaṃ vadet ihata (tu) sthito'muṣyapadaṃ vadet śrotraghrāṇapade prāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciram pāśādyāni prayojyaivaṃ prāṇamantraṃ samuddharet kṛtvā sakṛdevāthavā japet mantreṇa mantrī saṃsthāpayedasūn jīva iha sthita itīrayet prāṇā ihāyāntu svāhānto manurīritaḥ kavargeṇa viyatpūrvairhṛdīritam śikhākarmendriyaistadvattavargādyaistanucchadam buddhyādyairyādisaṃyuktairastramasya prakīrtitam praṇavo'gnivadhūrbījaṃ śaktiruktā maniṣibhiḥ bāṇaśūle ca kapālaṃ dadhatīṃ karaiḥ pratilomena saṃjapya mūlamantraṃ tataḥ sudhīḥ varairupacāraiḥ prapūjayet śālidhānyādi yathāvattatra vinyaset kumbhamastrābbhiḥ kṣālitāntaram dūrvākṣatānvitaṃ mantrī navaratnodaraṃ śubham kṣīradrumakaṣāyeṇa palāśatvagbhavena vā japtvā mūlamantraṃ tathaiva ca nikṣipya cūtādyaiḥ pidhāya saphalākṣatam kṣaumayugmena veṣṭayet ṣoḍaśabhirviśeṣo'yamudīritaḥ nīlaṃ ca navaratnakam pañcaratnāni yadvā kumbhe viniḥkṣipet

brāhmaṇāṃścaiva tanuṃ tasmai samarpayet svahṛdayamānayedgurusattamaḥ kaṇṭhikāṃ yāvannābhervidyāṃ pravinyaset śāntyatītāṃ pravinyasya vyutkrameṇa ca bodhayet śirasi dattvā dūrvākṣataṃ guruḥ priyaṃ śiṣyaṃ tuṣṭo deśikasattamaḥ vyastahastābhyāṃ pādau saṃgṛhya daiśikau bhūtaśuddhikalānyāsau tataḥ śiṣye samācaret devatāṃ śiṣye saṃkrāntāṃ paricintayet jalandattvaiṣāmuko mantra āvayoḥ devatāgurumantrāṇāmaikyaṃ saṃbhāvya daṇḍavat devi sarvasaṃpattisaṃśraye pāśaiḥ pāśitasya sureśvari aihikāmuṣmikairbhāgyairabhisaṃvarddhyatāmasau ṛṣyādisaṃyuktaṃ mantraṃ śravasi dakṣiṇe sarvatantreṣu māntrikaistantravedibhiḥ vittaśāṭhyaṃ parityajya śiṣyaḥ saṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ tadardhaṃ vā yathāśaktyathavā budhaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrtitantre śrī gārgyasaṃhitā vyarthakarmāṇau sāṅgācchrautātphalaṃyataḥ budho japtvā mantrī mantrārthasiddhaye dakṣiṇāndadyādbrāhmaṇānapi bhojayet śiṣyo dīkṣitaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ mantrāśaktiḥ prasaktā yā dattamantrasya mantriṇaḥ ṛṣyādīnnyāsādīnarcanāmapi

nānyadanveṣituṃ bhavet sarvamanantaphaladaṃ bhavet gṛhītaṃ yattasmin kāle gurornṛṣu dīkṣādi sati saṃbhave prakurvāṇo māsarkṣādi na śodhayet yatkaiścidityuktaṃ tadamūlakamiṣyate sadyodhivāsavidhinā sarvaśiṣṭānusārataḥ taddānamapyasau kuryātpāpakṣayaṃ yataḥ dīkṣāyāgavihīno'pītyādau kā (vā) gatirbhavet tathācedaṃ pravarteta gurorapi dīkṣāmityādiśiṣyavākyavirodhataḥ ca vidhābupalakṣaṇamucyate yakṣye'haṃ tatra tvaṃ me gururbhava dīkṣāsāmānyakālo'thamantrāṇāmabhidhīyate dīkṣā gurorājñānurūpataḥ kāraṇaṃ kintu svecchāvāpte tu sadgurau vidhinā saṃkṣiptena pravarttayet gandhapuṣpābhyāmarcitaṃ vastrabhūṣitam kṛtvā hunedaṣṭottaraṃ [jepedityarthaḥ] śatam prokṣaṇītoyaiḥ śāntikumbhajalaistathā sampādayanmantraṃ hastaṃ śirasi dhārayan vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śaileyaṃ rajanīdvayam kaściccedabjamabhyarcya [śaṃkhamityarthaḥ] sākṣatam japetkarṇe upadeśe tvayaṃ vidhiḥ

mantramātraprakathanamupadeśaḥ sa ucyate śaṅkhatoyamupādāya sapuṣpakuśacandanaiḥ saṃvadatyenaṃ manuṃ śrīgārgya saṃhitā dakṣiṇe karṇe kathayettrirgurūttamaḥ samutthāya daṇḍavatpraṇamedgurum kurvīta gurupriyamananyadhīḥ brahmacaryādiniyamān dīkṣākarmavadācaret droṇamite japenmantraṃ sahasrakam vidhānena tvarimantrādvimucyate mantravimuktaḥ syāditi śiṣṭaparamparā vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ deśakālādividdeśe deśe deśika ucyate svaduḥkhakaraṇenāpi paraṃ parasukhodyataḥ śānto viṣayeṣvapi nispṛhaḥ saṃhartuṃ samartho brāhmaṇottamaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavijayavyagro'nugro vitatamānasaḥ saparyāsu paraḥ puramuradviṣoḥ puraścaraṇakṛtsiddhaḥ siddhamantraḥ prayogavit madhyadeśakurukṣetralāṭāṅkola samudbhavāḥ sāndhodbhavāḥ saurā māgadhāḥ keralāstathā gurubhaktaśca jijñāsuḥ śraddhayā saha cirantadārādhanakṛddehena draviṇena ca prāpyaṃ prāyo vṛddhimateṅgitam śiṣyaḥ syāt svayaṃ yatamānasaḥ śuddhiṃ buddhimantamalolupamam

mṛṣāhīnamahīnadravyamānasam svādhīnamanādhiṃ vyādhivarjitam virataṃ paradūṣaṇe smarantamasmarābādhaṃ smitopetamavismitam guruḥ śiṣyaṃ na gṛhṇīyātkadācana rājñi patyau jāyākṛto yathā lobhād yo'nugṛhṇātyadīkṣayā mātāpitrormahībhṛti vāniṣṭamādiṣṭaṃ guruṇā yattu gurvapi manasā vācā sadā bhaktiparo gurum ca yā ca marmanikṛntinī ramyamatyutkaṭaṃ cāpi manaso'pi samīpsitam samyagācāryaṃ yaḥ samarcayet kṛtakṛtyaḥ sa vai śiṣyaḥ paratreha ca nandati catuṣkoṣṭhe koṇasūtracatuṣṭayam dve dve mantrī yāmyottarāyate pātayedeṣu matsyeṣu samaṃ sūtracatuṣṭayam matsyeṣu dadyātsūtracatuṣṭayam yāvacchatadvayaṃ mantrī ṣaṭ pañcāśatpadānyapi padairmadhye likhetpadmaṃ salakṣaṇam dvāraśobhopaśobhādīn śiṣṭābhyāṃ parikalpayet saṃtyajya dvādaśā (śāṃ) śaṃ tataḥ sudhīḥ karṇikāsthānaṃ kesarāṇāṃ dvitīyakam bāhyavṛttāntarālasya mānaṃ yadvidhinā sudhīḥ sandhisaṃsthāni tatra sūtrāṇi pātayet

tanmadhyasūtrasyobhayataḥ sudhīḥ yugaśaḥ kesarāṇi prakalpayet pādārthaṃ pīṭhakoṇeṣu mārjayet vīthisaṃsthāni mārjayetpaṃktyabhedataḥ padaistribhistathaikena śobhāḥ syurdvārapārśvayoḥ padaiḥṣaḍbhiḥ koṇānāṃ syāccatuṣṭayam haridrācūrṇaṃ syāt sitaṃ taṇḍulasaṃbhavam śyāmamityuktaṃ varṇapañcakam pītavarṇena kesarāṇyaruṇena ca rañjayenmantrī yadvā pītaiva karṇikā kṛṣṇāvarṇāḥ syuḥ pītenāpyasitena vā tasya śuklāni vīthiṣvapi catasṛṣu varṇairnānāvidhaiścitrāḥ sarvadṛṣṭimanoharāḥ pītavarṇā koṇānyasitabhāni ca sarvatobhadrametat sādhāraṇaṃ matam pātayettatra sūtrāṇi koṣṭhānāṃ dṛśyate śatam koṣṭhaiḥ prakalpayet pīṭhaṃ paṃktā naivātra vīthikā padaiḥ kuryāt ṣaḍbhiḥ koṇāni mantravit proktaṃ sarvasamṛddhidam prakurvīta sapramāṇaṃ nigadyate vihīne pāpavīkṣitaiḥ saṃyukte puraścaraṇamācaret hi pañcāṅgakamudīritam puraścaraṇamākhyātaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ mantrisattamaiḥ dvīpāntaragataṃ ca yat

pañcāṅgametatkurvīta yaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ budhaḥ mantrasya suprasannāntarātmanaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ kuryāt sa sarveṣu viśiṣyate dharmo nānena sadṛśaṃ tapaḥ p. 30) nānena sādhakaṃ kiṃcidiṣṭārthasya kadācana tathātvaṃ cenmelakaṃ nātiricyate kṛtāḥ pañcatatheti cet militāṅgaḥ syāditi cennoktadoṣataḥ pañcāṅgatetyetat pañcāvayavatārthakam amūlalakṣaṇāpatterdṛṣṭānto naiva saṃgataḥ saṃkalpo vratamucyate tatra pañcāṅgatāsthiteḥ vihīyetetyādyapyetena yujyate bhaktyā puraścaraṇamucyate sakalasaṃmatyā tatpuraścaraṇaṃ matam nānātantreṣvapyetadeva vyavasthitam iṣṭaviśeṣo'sāviti tarkavido viduḥ śukle'bje trinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ gurum tubhyamiṣṭadeva svarūpiṇe gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ na siddhistasyanānyathā bhaktistasya siddhiradūrataḥ darśite tattve tatkṣaṇāttanmayo bhavet savidyovā gurureva sadā gatiḥ hyarthāḥ prakāśante manīṣiṇaḥ

pacyate puruṣādhamaḥ gurorevaṃ śiṣyaḥ śivamayo bhavet tathā chāyāṃ laṅghayenna kadācana dīkṣāvyākhyāṃ prabhutvādi guroragre parityajet kurvanti pāpiṣṭhāḥ puruṣādhamāḥ śaśvadārādhyā guravohyavamānitāḥ mohāt paruṣaṃ pravadanti ye duṣkṛtaṃ tanna saṃśayaḥ sadā kāryā sā hi prathamasādhanam viśvāsaścaitat siddheśca lakṣaṇam kiṃ japaiścaiva kiṃ mantranyāsavistaraiḥ hi mantrasya prathamaṃ bījamucyate tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ nadītīraṃ guhā parvatamastakam viviktāni bilvamūlaṃ taṭaṃ gireḥ aśvatthāmalakīmūlaṃ gośālā jalamadhyataḥ saṃnidhānaṃ ca cittaikāgrasthalaṃ tathā sthānamāśritya japamācaret kāmbalaṃ duḥkhamocanam rogaharaṃ vaiyāghraṃ sarvasiddhidam dhavalaṃ proktaṃ vicitraṃ sarvakarmasu tathoccāṭe khaḍgijaṃ vaśyakarmaṇi dāridryaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ dārujāsane tṛṇāsane yaśohāniḥ pallave cittavibhramaḥ taduktamāgamārthānāṃ siddhaśaivāgamādiṣu

śrīmān dāridryādyādhiduḥkhadam kambalaṃ vā kalpayedāsanaṃ mṛdu viśedyatirvanasthaśca brahmacārī ca snātakaḥ dvihastaṃ vā caturasraṃ samantataḥ svāstikādīni vakṣyāmi cāsanānyatha sattama praśastameteṣu pūjite punarādime jānūrvorantare kṛtvā samyak pādatale ume vinyasya dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ budhaḥ karābhyāmaṅguṣṭhe nidhāya cibukaṃ hṛdi naivamākhyātaṃ padmāsanamidaṃ budhaiḥ pādaṃ nyasedvāmaṃ tathānyataḥ syādidamityavagamyatām ubhābhyāmūrūmūlābhyāmagrapādāvubhāvapi vīrāsanamudīritam vinyasya vajrāsanamudīritam yābhirviracitābhiśca modante mantradevatāḥ vidadhau veṇuṃpadmamālāgadāḥ kramāt śrīvatsakaustubhau parśurgāruḍī mohanī parā cāsya viṣṇoretāḥ prakīrtitaḥ kapālā ca ḍamaruḥ śivamudrikāḥ parśulaḍḍū bījapūrā gaṇeśituḥ mausalī daurgī lakṣmīmudrāstadarcane saptajihvāhvayā mudrā vijñeyā vahnipūjane saṃkṣobhamudrā prathamā dvitīyā karṣiṇīmatā tathā yonistathāveśakarī parā

kumbhamudrābhiṣekesyāt prārthane prārthanāhvayā kālakarṇīkumbhanādabinduvismayasaṃjñikāḥ yatra tatra tāṃ viniyojayet uddeśānukramādāsāmucyante lakṣaṇāni ca tasyāgraṃ pīḍayitvā ca dakṣahastāṅgulīgaṇaiḥ sthāpayeduccaranmantraṃ māraṃ bilvāhvayā matā saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇena tu muṣṭinā vāmāṅgulyastathā śliṣṭāḥ saṃyutāḥ suprasāritāḥ oṣṭhe vāmakarāṅguṣṭho lagnastasya kaniṣṭhikā tarjanīmadhyamānāmāḥ kiṃcitsaṅkocya cālitāḥ bhavenmudrā sā vācyānupadaṃ punaḥ karadvayenamālāvanmudreyaṃ vanamālikā viṣṇoḥ santoṣavarddhinī bhavedeṣā vaktavyaṃ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ badhnīyāt kaniṣṭhāmūlasaṃśrite anāmāspṛṣṭasaṃlagnā dakṣiṇasya kaniṣṭhikā vāmānāmāñcabadhnīyāddakṣāṅguṣṭhasya mūlake catasro'pyagrasaṃlagnā mudrākaustubhasaṃjñikā śliṣṭe śliṣṭāvaṅguṣṭhakau tathā garuḍamudrāsyād viṣṇoḥ santoṣakāriṇī jānumadhye karau kṛtvā cibukoṣṭhau samāvṛtau bhavedeṣā mudrā tatprītivardhinī saṃproktā mudrā vārāhasaṃjñikā madhyamāṃ tāsāmunnamyātha vikuñcayet saṃpuṭīkṛtya prasṛtāṅgulikau tathā

kāmamudreyamuditā sarvadevapriyaṅkarī dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhena veṣṭayet vāmāṅgalīrdakṣiṇābhiraṅgulībhiśca bandhayet kaniṣṭhike baddhvā tarjanībhyāmanāmike aṅguṣṭhāgradvayaṃ nyasyedyonimudreyamīritā prasārayedakṣamālā'nupadaṃ ca varābhaye khaṭvāṅgapātravadvāmahastaṃ vāmāṅgake nyaset śithilāṃ baddhvā kiṃciducchiritamadhyamām ḍamarukā mṛgamudrā juhotiṣu talāntarmilitāṅguṣṭhā padmamudrā vivasvataḥ madhyā saralābaddhamuṣṭikā tarjanīmadhyamāsandhinirgatāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭikā vāmamuṣṭisthatarjanyā dakṣamuṣṭisthatarjanī pāśāhvayā mudrā vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitā talaṃ ca karayostiryak saṃyojya cāṅgulīḥ bījapūrā ca prasiddhatvādupekṣitā pāśāṅkuśau nigaditau pūrvameva yathāvidhi vāmahastaḥ prasṛto'bhayamudrikā śiṣṭāṅgulī tu prasṛte saṃmṛṣṭe khaḍgamudrikā kaniṣṭhāṃ ca vāmāṅguṣṭhena pīḍayet tarjanyā dīrghayāvāṇamudrikā ākuñcitāṅguliṃ kuryāccarmamudreyamīritā mauśalī mūrdhni kṛtā daurgyeva sā bhavet tathānīya tadagreṅguṣṭhakau kṣipet vīṇāmudreyamākhyātā sarasvatyāḥ priyaṅkarī

saṃhatottānā proktā vyākhyānamudrikā maṇibandhasthitau kṛtvā prasṛtāṅgulikau karau saptajihvākhyamudreyaṃ vaiśvānarapriyaṅkarī madhyamāmadhyage kṛtvā kaniṣṭhe'ṅguṣṭhabo (ro) dhite mudrā sarvasaṃkṣobhakāriṇī aṅkuśākārarūpābhyāṃ madhyage parameśvari matā kṛtvā tarjanyau kuṭilākṛtī samākhyātā tripurāhvānakarmaṇi tadbahistarjanīdvayam mudraiṣonmādinī proktā kledinī sarvayoṣitām tathaiva hi kaniṣṭhike bhavedeṣā tripurātoṣakāriṇī sarvāḥ aṅguṣṭhāvagradeśataḥ adhaḥ kṛtvāṅkuśākṛtī sarvakāmārthasādhinī maheśāni hastau saṃparivartayet samākrānte sarvordhvamapi madhyame nāmnā mudrā sarvottamottamā tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayugalaṃ yugapatkārayettataḥ yojye sarvādhastādanāmike parāṅguṣṭhe kṣiptvā hastadvayena tu dhyānamudrāsyādvāsudevāhvayā ca sā tāvevābhimukhau kuryāt bālakarṇyabhirakṣaṇe sarvarakṣākarīhyeṣā kuntamudrā samīritā

tarjanyaṅguṣṭhasaṃyogādagrato bindumudrikā vismayasaṃjñā syāt vismayāveśakāriṇī aṅguṣṭhau saṃhatau kāryau hṛdi kacchapikā bhavet tattvamudreyamuditā mahāpātakanāśinī sādhayamānastu trisandhyaṃ devamarcayet cittagatā kāryā kāryaṃ va hṛdayaṃsthiram nityaṃ gatvā vandeta svaṃgurum kuryāt saṅgamaṃ sādhubhiḥ saha tilakalkena vā kṛtī triṣavaṇaṃ snānamaśaktau dviḥ sakṛttathā kāmyakarmāṇi tathā sādhusamāgamam asatyabhāṣaṇaṃ coktiṃ kuṭilāṃ parivarjayet satyaiḥ prastutasādhakaḥ karmabhirnityaṃ niḥspṛho vanitādiṣu puṣpadhāraṇameva ca smaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ keliḥ prekṣaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇam proktaṃ maithunaṃ tantravedibhiḥ dvijāñchūdrān striyo naiva spṛśettadā puraścaraṇakṛdbījaḥ gośuśrūṣādikaṃ caiva kalpoktaṃ vidhivaccaret tantrānusāreṇa mantriṇāṃ hitakāmyayā payo mūlaṃ phalaṃ vāpi yadyadyatropapadyate bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ śākāni payomūlaṃ phalaṃ tathā sitāsvinnaṃ dhānyaṃ mudgāstilā yavāḥ ṣaṣṭikākālaśākaṃ ca mūlakaṃ kemuketarat

payo'nuddhṛtasāraṃ ca panasāmraharītakī lavalīdhātrīphalānyaguḍamaikṣavam mukhyāstadanu vrīhayaḥ smṛtāḥ sarvābhāve'pi varjayet satkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśīlo'grajanmanām brahmottaraṃ viṇṇurmadhyapatraṃ maheśvaraḥ vahistīrthāt pragṛhṇīyādaparvaṇi viśuddhādadhikerāgādgṛhīte naiva sidhyati yathā vṛddhistathābhuñjīta sādhakaḥ parityājyaṃ duṣṭānnaṃ mantribhiḥ sadā jalādvṛddhistaroryadvadindriyāṇāṃ tathānnataḥ tathā kṣāralavaṇaṃ tailameva ca gṛñjanaṃ bilvaṃ kalañjaṃ laśunaṃ tathā kāṃsyapātre ca divābhojanameva ca siddhiṃ nāpnoti sādhakaḥ cāpi mantriṇāṃ hitakāmyayā varṇamālaiva gadyate siddhikāṃkṣiṇām sāṣṭavargaiḥ kliptayā varṇamālayā vairimantrā api nṝṇāmanye mantrāśca kiṃ punaḥ varṇayuktatvaṃ prathamaṃ varṇamuccaret tasya siddhiradūrataḥ vinā karma kṛtaṃ tadaphalaṃ bhavet tistroṅgulyāstriparvāḥ syurmadhyamācaika parvikā pradakṣiṇamanukramam madhyamānāmāmadhyaparvayugātmakam

ārabhyamadhyamāmūlaparyantaṃ gaṇayedbudhaḥ tu kṣidreṣu sravate japaḥ yajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet yasmānniyataṃ gaṇayedbudhaḥ prakurvīta nityaṃ kāmyaṃ ca sādhakaḥ tadvarṇasaṃkhyamālābhirjapamālā prakalpayet padmākṣāḥ puṣṭilakṣmīdāḥ śatrunāśakarāḥ sadā racitā mālā saubhāgyaṃ vipulāṃ śriyam tanute tadvat sphāṭikyapyakṣamālikā mālā sarvān kāmān prayacchati kauśī rudrākṣādikuśāntakaiḥ uccāṭane'śvadantānāṃ mālāḥ protāścabālakaiḥ grathitairnirmitāmālā śatrūṇāṃ nāśinī matā keśaiḥ protavyā dveṣakarmaṇi śastā indrākṣairaktacandanaiḥ aṅgulījapasaṃkhyānamekamevamudāhṛtam maliratnaiśca daśasāhasrakaṃ smṛtam svarṇairdaśaguṇā saiva sarvaiḥ śataguṇaṃ tathā śuddhapadmākṣamālābhirapisyādamitaṃ phalam śataiḥ kuryātsarvasādhāraṇe jape aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvasiddhiruktā kṛtasrajā puṣṭyarthī saptaviṃśatyā pañcadaśyābhicārike pakṣayostasmādvikalpaḥ syādvyavasthitaḥ mantribhiḥ vidyāyādau sādhako grathayet svayam

taccandanasakāśena puṣpasrakparamiṣyate yathākāmamakṣāṇyānīya yatnataḥ kīṭādibhiraduṣṭāni na jīrṇāni navāni vai dvijapuṇyastrīnirmitaṃ triguṇīkṛtam tathā kṛṣṇaṃ vaśyaśāntyabhicārike sthāpayetpadmaūpeṇāśvatthanavapallavān tāraṃ śaktiṃ mātṛkāṃ ca sūtrai caiva maṇiṣvatha homasaṃkhyādviguṇaṃ japamācaret maṇimekaikamādāya sūtre vai yojayetsudhīḥ gopucchasadṛśī kāryā yadvā sarpākṛtiḥśubhā brahmagranthiṃ prakalpayet gāyatrīmantrakathanaṃ brahmagranthiprakalpane vidhāyetthaṃ tasyāstvatiśayārthakān kṣālayetpañcagavyena sadyojātena sajjalaiḥ tarpayet puruṣeṇa tu pañcamenaiva tato mantreṇa mantrayet kṛtākṣamālāyāṃ japenmātṛkayā sudhīḥ sakalamantrāṇāṃ japaḥ kāryo'nayāsrajā spṛśedenāṃ karabhraṣṭāṃ na kārayet spṛśetso'yaṃ muktido gaṇanakramaḥ aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu japeduttama karmaṇi mantraṃ gopayecca nijaṃ gurum prakāśayedvidvān mantraṃ naiva prakāśayet bhūtarākṣasavetālāḥ siddhagandharvacāri(ra)ṇāḥ sūtraṃ prayuñjīta na truṭyati jape yathā

bhavedvighnaṃ chinnāyāṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam pramādātpatite hastācchatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet śatādijapasaṃkhyātra mātṛkāyā vidhīyate syādakṣarāvṛttiḥ sa ca trividha īritaḥ japayajñānāṃ śreyānsyāduttarottaraḥ mantramuccārayedvyaktaṃ vācikaḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ kiṃcicchravaṇayogyaḥ syādupāṃśuḥ sajapaḥ smṛtaḥ uccairjapo'viśiṣṭaḥ syādupāṃśurdaśabhirguṇaiḥ caiva puṣṭikāma upāṃśukaḥ samaḥprokto goṣṭhe daśaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ nadyāṃ lakṣamudīritam saṃkhyātaḥ sahasraguṇa ucyate hṛdgatāṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca hṛdayaṃ sthiram śanairavispaṣṭamadrutaṃ na vilambitam nairantaryavidhiḥ prokto na dinaṃ vyatilaṅghayet śānto virataḥ paradūṣaṇe prātaḥkālānmadhyaṃdināvadhi bhrāntastvarāyuktaḥ śayāno vā nirāsanaḥ vāpi muktakeśo galāvṛtaḥ gacchannutthita eva vā cintāvyākulacitto vā na mantraṃ prajapedbudhaḥ kṣajjṛmbhaṇahikkādivikalīkṛtamānasaḥ darbhaśayyāyāṃ vinyasecchucirātmanaḥ uparyadhobahirvastraviparyāsaṃ na kārayet varjayettaṃ prayatnataḥ

japetpādāvutkaṭāsana eva vā japakāle vivarjayet śrute'dhovāyugamane jṛmbhaṇejapamutsṛjet samyagjapeccheṣaṃ yadvā sūryādidarśanam śrīnāradīyake doṣāḥ kathyante siddhibodhinaḥ manoryasyādimadhyānteṣvānilaṃ bījamucyate pañcadhāvātha samantraśchinnasaṃjñakaḥ vijñeyo bhuktimuktivivarjitaḥ prokto hakāro bīja saṃyutaḥ manuryaḥ syādrephārkenduvivarjitaḥ ādimadhyāvasāneṣu haṃsaḥ prāsādavāgurau padaṃ nāsti yasmin sa kīlitaḥ mantraḥsyāt stambhitaḥ siddhibo(ro)dhakaḥ taṃ tu dagdhaṃ manvīta mantravit mukhena praṇavaḥ sthitaḥ ādimadhyāvasāneṣu bhavennārṇacatuṣṭayam vā krodho vā mūrdhani dvidhā hṛdaye śīrṣe vaṣaṭvauṣaṭ ca madhyataḥ haṃsahīno yaḥ suṣuptaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ pañcakādiryo madonmatta udāhṛtaḥ virāmasthānagaṃ yasya hṛtavīryaḥ sa kathyate ityeṣa yaḥ syādaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ hṛllekhāṅkuśabījāḍhyastaṃ prasuptaṃ pracakṣate yuvā prauḍhaścatvāriṃśallipirmanuḥ

catuḥśatākṣaraścāpi vṛddha ityabhidhīyate hṛdayaṃ śiro mantrau ca madhyataḥ śivaśaktyarṇahīno vā sa nirbīja iti smṛtaḥ siddhihīnaḥ syānmandaḥ paṃktyakṣaro manuḥ śaktihīnaḥ syāccaturvarṇastu kekaraḥ sārdhadvādaśavarṇo vā dhūmitaḥ sa tu ninditaḥ viṃśatyarṇastriṃśadarṇo yaḥ syādāliṅgitastu saḥ caturviṃśativarṇo yaḥ saptaviṃśativarṇakaḥ ekādaśākṣarī vāpi pañca viṃśatisaṃkhyakaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaro ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṇakastathā aṣṭāviṃśadakṣaro yaḥ ekatriṃśadathāpi vā mantrastrayastriṃśadathāpi vā triṣaṣṭiryāvadāpatet pañcaṣaṣṭyakṣarāyesyurmantrāste śāntamānasāḥ nigaditāḥ sthānabhraṣṭāhvayābudhaiḥ vikalāste'bhidhīyante śataṃ sārdha śatastu (ntu) vā yatsaṃkhyā nisnehāste samīritā yāgeṣu parityājyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ dvisahasrādhikā mantrāḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ śatadhā matāḥ vidyāśca boddhavyā mantribhiḥ sarvakarmasu tadāvaśyakamevātra tadvyaktaṃ śāradādike tasya kalpakoṭiśatairapi śodhayedūrdhvapavano baddhayā yonimudrayā sarveṣu hṛllekhā kāmabījakam tārasaṃpuṭito vātha duṣṭamantro'pi siddhyati

śatrunkāmādīn yogamabhyaset duḥkhadānetānariṣaḍvargamātmanaḥ yamaniyamāsanaprāṇāyāmāḥ tataḥ param aṣṭāṅgānyāhuretāni yogino yogasādhane dhṛtirmitāhāraḥ śaucaṃ ceti yamā daśa siddhāntaśravaṇaṃ caiva hrīrmatiścajapodga(vra)tam vicaratāṃ viṣayeṣu nirargalam aṅguṣṭhagulphajānūrusīvanīliṅganābhiṣu mastake mūrdhni dvādaśānte yathā vidhi caitanyāntaravartinā nityaṃ devātmaparamātmanoḥ yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu samārabhya viśudhāntaranāḍikaḥ liṅge vāmapārṣṇima (tha) nyaset kākacañcuyutakramāt karṇau tarjanībhyāṃ tu locane aṅgulībhirnātidṛḍhamavarudhya svakaṃ manaḥ saṃtyajya purīṣantu punaḥ punaḥ hūṁkṛtenoccārayedgudamārutam praviśyājagranthiṃ bhitvājapaṅkajam kramānmeghaninādābho jāyate tena budhyate vikasadbandhujīvapuṣpābhamujjvalam tayaikīkṛtamātmānaṃ yogī kuṇḍalinīṃ tataḥ citranāḍyā sahasradalapaṅkajam tatkarṇikāsaṃsthaśivasāyujyamāpnuyāt

nipataṃtrīṃ(ntīṃ)mantramayīṃ lohitāmṛtaviśru(sru)tim vṛtya prīṇayantī svasthānamadhigacchati mantrajāpavidhānena doṣān chinnādikān haret ciraṃjīvetsmarātmakaḥ padmaṃ brahmaṇo bhūṣitaṃ dalaiḥ prāhurmūlādhāraṃ tu yoginaḥ śivasthānaṃ svādhiṣṭhānasamāhvayam daśākṣarairdalairyuktaṃ nābhisthaṃ maṇipūrakam dalairādityasaṃkhyābhiḥ kādivarṇairvibhūṣitaiḥ nalinaṃ kaṇṭhe'lirucibhiryutam śaraccandramayukhābhamājñānāmasaroruham ṣaṭcakrakamidaṃ proktaṃ yogaśāstraviśāradaiḥ cakreśāḥ ṣaḍatra parikīrtitāḥ cakreśāḥ kvacidevamudīritāḥ ceti kramāt ṣaṭcakradevatāḥ hṛdibālā(ṇā)dvayaṃ liṅgamitarañcā(ccā)ntarālake sphuradraśmi triśṛṅga(ṅgaṃ)himaraśmikam dviguṇavistāravṛttarūpeṇa veṣṭitam śritābhāgaṃ tanorvāmaṃ tu dakṣiṇam brahmarandhraṃ tu citrā nāḍī tadantare janārdano rudraḥ śivasādākhyakāvapi trikoṇāsti yonirlohitadīdhitiḥ cintanīyastaḍinnibhaḥ tanmadhye śivaśaktisvarūpiṇī prasuptabhujagākārā śaṃkhāvartabhramānmukham

yonimudrāyā bandha evaṃ prakīrtitaḥ paścāttāḍanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathā guptirdaśaitā mantrasaṃskriyāḥ mantrīsauvarṇalekhinyā mātṛkārṇān yathākramam avaśiṭairmātṛkārṇaiḥ saṃpuṭīkṛtya taṃ japet kṛtvā mantravarṇān japetsudhīḥ samālikhya tāḍayeccandanāmbhasā samālikhya prasūnaiḥ karavīrajaiḥ aśvatthapallavairmantramabhiṣiñcedviśuddhaye yonibandhorddhvapavanastadutthajyotiṣā tataḥ mantrī vimalīkaraṇaṃ tvidam pratyarṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ manoḥ tantre tarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ matam gopanaṃ tvaprakāśanam vidhinā mantrī yathoktaphalamaśnute dadyād varaṃ dakṣe niveśayet navanītaṃ ca dadhibhāṇḍaṃ tathā guḍam vīṇāṃ tathā nāgaṃ vyañjanaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum pakṣiṇaṃ mudrāṃ dakṣiṇe viniyojayet pāśaṃ ca pustaṃ ca pātraṃ vāme vicintayet phalaṃ khaḍgaṃ triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathā dhanurvāṇaṃ cobhayorhastakaṅkaṇaṃ mudrikāṃ gadām arghapātraṃ cobhayostu dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ tathā sarvadevānāṃ pītaṃ viṣṇoḥ samīritam nṛsiṃhācyu vā nā go pe ha kṛ kramāt

siddhirbhavedāśu abhāgyasyāpi dehinaḥ tathāsyāmukagotrasya puraścaraṇasiddhaye vāpi krośaṃ gavyūtimeva vā mānaṃ kvacinmānaṃ na vidyate sthānaṃ krośayugmamathāpi vā kṛtvā pratyekaṃ vai kadāpi vā cāstraṃ samabhyarcya mantrī pañcopacārakaiḥ mantrī na vighnaiḥ paribhūyate svavargeṇa saṃpūjya vidhivattataḥ samāśritya kūrmacakraṃ vicintayet vargān lakṣamīśe madhyakoṣṭhe tathā likhet ubhe pāṇau dve śiṣṭaṃ pucchamīritam hyudāsīnaḥ pārśvasthoduḥkhamāpnuyāt kūrmacakramidaṃ proktaṃ mantriṇāṃ siddhisādhanam vāpi yatra kutrāvaloyan kūrmacakramavijñāya yaḥ kuryājjapahomakam vidhāyādāvekabhuktaṃ samācaret svarṇadānādikaṃ kuryādathavā sarvakāmadam santarpayet samyak bhojanācchādanābhiḥ paścāt tadanujñāpurassaram svagurormanasaiva samācaret prakurvīta haviṣyānnena taddine kṛtāvaśyakriyo dhīraḥ upaviśyāsane śubhe paramātmānaṃ vyākhyāmudrālasatkaram dhyātvā ca tatpādasrutapīyūṣadhārayā

hṛdaye dhyātvā dehaṃ svaṃ paricintayet vinyasetpaścān mantrārthaṃ saṃsmaranbudhaḥ paścātsvamantra-ṛṣyādinyāsapūrvakamādarāt tattīrthaṃ mudrayā dhenusaṃjñayā dhyātvā taccaraṇasṛ(sru)te mantrī kuryātsandhyādikāṃ kriyām mūlamanuṃ tvaṣṭāviṃśati pramitaṃ tataḥ mūrdhni tadvatkalaśamudrayā tripurādevi vidmahe padamīrayet ityabhidhāyātha vadet klinne pracodayāt trailokyamohanāyeti vidmahe padamīrayet śrīhareḥ proktā sakalārthapradāyinī ityabhidhāyānte vadedrāmaḥ pracodayāt kāmadevāya vidmahe puṣpabāṇāya dhīmahi gāyatrī proktā sakalasiddhidā tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt vidmahe mahājvālāya dhīmahi gāyatrī proktā sarvasamṛddhidā pravadettannaścaṇḍaḥ pracodayāt divākarāya dhīmahi samuddiṣṭā gāyatrī sarvasiddhidā tanmantradevatānāmnā gāyatrīṃ tatra kalpayet sūrya-ādityetyaṣṭārṇena ca bhānave dikpatīnnatvā tataḥ saṃkalpamācaret havanaṃ homāddaśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tataḥ

puraścaraṇamevaṃ hi kariṣye prāgudaṅmukhaḥ kuśākṣatajalairevaṃ saṃkalpaḥ śāstradarśitaḥ ito'nyathā vadantyeke sampradāyānusāriṇaḥ bhāvenāpyuttarottaraśaṃsitā tribhāgahīnaṃ pakṣaṃ vā tribhāgaṃ tvardhameva vā brāhmaṇānāṃ tu na karmaviniveśitam japasyaiva daśāṃśataḥ daśāṃśenāpi vidyāyā devatāṃ cintayedapi prakṣālayedgatvā tato maṇḍapasaṃnidhim saṃśodhya hṛnmantreṇa prapūrya ca gandhapuṣpāṇi niḥkṣipettāramuccaran darśayettatvamudrāṃ ca sāmānyārghamidaṃ bhavet vāme gaṇeśaṃ ca sarasvatīm dakṣiṇaśākhāyāṃ vighnaṃ kṣetreśamanyataḥ vidhātāraṃ śaṃkhapadmanidhī tathā tattadvārādhipān yajet pracaṇḍo'thabalaścaiva prabalo bhadra ityapi nandisaṃjño mahākālo gaṇeśo vṛṣabhastathā vakratuṇḍaścaikadaṃṣṭro mahodaragajānanau vighnāḥ śākteyāḥ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ vārāhyanantarendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā saptamī tathā yamo'tha varuṇaḥ kuberastraipurā matāḥ sakṛtsyāddvārapālāṃśca sarvāṃstatraiva pūjayet divyāntarikṣabhaumāṃstu sarvavighnānnivārayet kṛtvā svāṅgaṃ saṃkocayan sudhīḥ

dvārāpekṣaṃ tu vāmatvamityetannānu manyate spṛśedetadvyākhyānamapi mantriṇām nārācāstradhiyā budhaḥ ye bhūtāste naśyantu śivājñayā diśi vāstvīśaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca samarcayet ye bhavantyatra sālasā mitabuddhayaḥ japamācaret tānāhustrividhān budhāḥ madhuparkācamanasnānavasanābharaṇāni ca prayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṁśca ṣoḍaśa sumanodhūpadīpanaivedyavandanam pūjā pañcopacārikī prakṣālyapāṇicaraṇau supavitrakaraḥ śuciḥ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭra mahākāya kalpāntadahanopama gṛhītvāsya sthānaśodhanamācaret ādhāraśaktimārabhya pṛthivyantāḥ prapūjayet ṛṣiścchandaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sutalaṃ matam mantrasya āsane parikīrtitaḥ dhāraya māṃ bhadre pavitrīkuru cāsanam svastikādikrameṇaiva ṛjukāyo viśedbudhaḥ jvalitasyāpi saṃnidhānaṃ prakalpayet pūjayetteṣu gaṇeśaṃ ca sarasvatīm sthāpanaṃ caitat puraścaryāparaṃ matam suvāsitāmbusampūrṇaṃ savye kumbhaṃ suśobhanam ghṛtaprajvalitāndīpān sthāpayetparitaḥ śubhān

bhūtvā vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ guruṃ dakṣe gaṇeśaṃ purato'mbikām mantreṇa rakṣāṃ kuryāt samantataḥ (rdde)na surabhīkṛtya hastakau saṃśodhya kuryāttālatrayaṃ tataḥ jyotirjñānasamudbhūtaṃ satyajñānasukhātmakam bhūtapretapiśācebhyo vidhāya tadanantaram prakṣipetparito vahnivigamāyātha sādhakaḥ jānuparyantaṃ caturasraṃ savajrakam jānvorānābhi candrārdhanibhaṃ padmena lāñchitam kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ trikoṇaṃ raktavarṇakam kaṇṭhādbhrūmadhyaparyantaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāyostu maṇḍalam bhrūmadhyādbrahmarandhrāntaṃ vartulaṃ dhvajalāñchitam dhyātvā punastāni būtāni pravilāpayet tathākāśe ākāśaṃ prakṛtau punaḥ parabrahmarūpastiṣṭhet kiyatkṣaṇam sā mātṛkā prakṛtiḥparā samīraṇādabhūdagnirvahnerāpastato mahī devatārādhanenaivamutpannamiti cintayet samastadevatārūpaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ vibhum mukhyā bhūtasuddhirudīritā sarvamantranidānaṃ tu guṇatrayavivarjitam dvādaśāntapade nītvā sthāṇuvadbhāvayedvapuḥ hṛdayasthena dahechuṣkaṃ kalevaram saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaṃ śubhraṃ cintayedamṛtātmakam

apivarṇamayaiścaiva pañcabhūtātmakaṃ vapuḥ bhūtānāṃ dehe sve paricintayet bhūtaśuddhirvidhīyate aiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ caiva paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikam tatkarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ pradīpakalikānibham so'haṃ mantreṇa sādhakaḥ tvakcakṣūrasanaghrāṇamukhapāṇipuraḥsaram rasaṃ ca gandhaṃ ca vāgādāne gatiṃ tathā bījabhāvena tatra līnāni cintayet kandagatairvātairekībhūtaṃ nabhasvatam śarīraṃ sthiradhīrdakṣiṇena tu recayet vilīnapavanaṃ vahnimaṇḍalasaṃsthitam dhyāyedanalasampūrṇāṃ kumbhake recake ca tām caivaṃ niścalāṅgo jitendriyaḥ pāthomaṇḍalasthamamṛtenaikatāṃ gatam prajapa - [nnatha kinnahi rūpyate kiñcātramantrajāpeṣu dhyānamva niyāmakam śāradādinibandha svaraso yataḥ viśeṣavidhimutsṛjya taduktaṃ śāradādike vikalpaḥ kiṃ na kalpyate caitat] kumbhake varṇamiśritām śarīradoṣajātāni viśleṣaṃ kārayettanum vāyuṃ dakṣeṇa recayet prāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyastarjanīmadhyame vinā bāhyādāpūraṇaṃ vāyorudare pūrako mataḥ

bahiryadrecanaṃ vāyorudarā (dre) cakopi saḥ tadvigarbhaṃ ca taddvayaṃ kathyate yathā vigarbhaṃ ca yogaśāstraviśāradāḥ ṣoḍaśadhājapyāt kumbhake taccaturguṇam hastaḥ svaṃ jānumaṇḍalam kramāttasya vyatyāsena samācaret śanairevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ calito vāyuranyathā hanti sādhakam sarvarogasamudbhavaḥ vividhā rogāḥ prāṇāyāma vyatikramāt tattvāni svasvasthānaṃ samānayet prāhurna svadehaṃ viśodhayet brahmahatyāśiraskaṃ ca svarṇasteyabhujadvayam tatsaṃyogipadadvandvamaṅgapratyaṅga pātakam khaḍgacarmadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kukṣau dakṣiṇataḥ smaret proktā yogaśāstraviśāradaiḥ jīvaṃ puṣkarasthe sadāśive gātraṃ sarvaṃ tadbhasma vāyunā balabhidā svamātmānaṃ vicintayet budbudamadhyasthaṃ prasphuratkāntimaṇḍalam ramyaṃ tadantaścintayedbudhaḥ yatamanāścintayennīpakānanam mārttaṇḍamaṇḍalaruciṃ caturdvārasuśobhanam udyadindudyutisitaṃ vitānavaralāñchitam parivāreṇa kṣetreśvara gaṇeśvarau

tato'ntaramarastrīṇāṃ gaṇān dhyāyedanākulaḥ tasya padmamaṣṭadalaṃ budhaḥ svāsanasthāṃ cintayitveṣṭadevatām anyatrāpyevamevasyādyadrūpāṃ sveṣṭadevatām sādhako haṃsarūpiṇam proktā tattvajñairmāntrikottamaiḥ sādhakavaro devatārādhanodyataḥ bhūtaśuddhiṃ vinā karturjapahomārcanakriyāḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhayā paścājjīvaṃ dehe nidhāpayet sthāpayeduktamantreṇa yathāvaditi māntrikāḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ vinyāsena vinā lipeḥ vinā japaṃ prāhuḥ niṣphalaṃ sakalāsuram samākhyātā devatā deśikottamaiḥ vidheyāni jātiyuktāni deśikaiḥ oṣṭhadantottamāṅgāsye doḥpatsaṃdhyagrakeṣu ca ca hṛtpūrvaṃ pāṇipādayuge tataḥ sarveṣu hṛtpūrvatvasamanvayaḥ mātrikāyā vinyāse'pīti kecana naitatsamāsākrāntatvāt pṛthaganvayavaiśasāt] sargarbindvantikāṃ nyaset ṭārṇādyāṃ sthitivartmanā sarvaṃkartumaśaktaścet sṛṣṭimātraṃ lipiṃ nyaset tato jñeyo pūjanādiṣu mantribhiḥ kāritā gamyate tayoḥ pratyekādubhayorāvaśyakatvamiti gamyate caturṇāmapi kīrtanāt

snānasaṃdhyādikepyevamanityatvaṃ bhaviṣyati cedvācyaṃ tattvanyāse'pi kā gatiḥ vaiṣṇavītantre tattvanyāsaṃ vidurbudhāḥ manuvaryeṇa yaṃ mantraṃ japtumicchati śūdraiśca kartavyo laukikenāsusaṃyamaḥ pūrvoktā saṃkhyā'śaktasya cānyathā yuktaṃ tyajedenamevaṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt kumbhakaśtaccaturguṇaḥ recakādikameke'tra prāṇāyāme kramaṃ viduḥ tadasatpūrakābhāve recakānupapattitaḥ iḍayākarṣayedvāyuṃ bāhyaṃ ṣoḍaśamātrayā prāṇāyāmamimaṃ prāhuriti ca kramabodhanāt kiṃca śeṣe pavanasaṃyame putrayācanam tataścamātṛkāṃ nyasyediti tantreṣu keṣucit sayorūrvoradharmādīn pravinyaset pīṭhamantrāntaṃ hṛdivinyasya taṃ smaret ṝṣyādīnviniyogāvadhi smaret tasya tatproktamṛṣerbhāvastadārṣakam saṃchādito devaiḥ purā mṛtyostu vai bhayāt mantrasya taddiṣṭā yā tu devatā mantrāḥ karmārthameva ca ṛṣicchandodaivatāni śirovadanahṛtsu ca tatkalpasaṃproktairaṅgamantraiḥ karadvaye namaḥ pūrva śirase vahnivallabhā

netrayorvauṣaḍityuktam astrāya phaḍiti kramāt mantraśāstraṃ tathā coktaṃ prāptamantreṇa dhīmatā japatarpaṇahomārcāsiddhamantrakṛtā api teṣāṃ sarvathaiva prakīrtitā badhnīyācchoṭikābhiḥ samantataḥ dīpikāyāṃ vinyasetpañcāṅgamaṅgulipañcake yacchāradāvākyaṃ tatṣaḍaṅgaparaṃ bhavet saṅkoco bādhakena vidhīyate upakramānusāreṇa viśeṣaparatā bhavet virahāttasyāstadabhāvaviniścayāt varmma netra pāṇitaleṣvapi aṅgahīnasya mantrasya svenaivāṅgāni kalpayet karayoraṅgavinyāse'grāṅguṣṭhādyaṅgamullikhet prāhuḥ keciduttānavedinaḥ tatkathaṃ tatrāṅguṣṭhādyullekha iṣyate lalāṭāderullekhastulyatābalāt arthāsaṅgatirapyatra na tathā tannigadyate hṛdayenāto buddhigamyanamaskriyā śiromantreṇa cottuṅgaṃ viṣayāhṛtirīritā (jo')sya tanuḥ proktā śikhāmantreṇamantriṇaḥ devo gṛhyate kavacantataḥ dṛśiyena syāttattejo netravācakam tābhyāmaniṣṭamākṣipya cālayetphaṭpadāgninā śrīgārgyasaṃhitāpyenamarthaṃ sākṣāduvāca vai tantre proktaṃ kaṇṭharaveṇatat

aṅguṣṭharahitāḥ pāṇiśākhā hṛdayaśīrṣayoḥ karayorubhayoḥ śākhāḥ kavace parikīrttitāḥ bhavedyatra tatrānāmāpi saṃsmṛtā aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ ya(t) viṣvagjanayati dhvanim ṣaḍaṅgamudrāstu sarvamantreṣu yojayet kuryādviśeṣakalpoktaṃ padanyāsādikaṃ tathā tattatkalpaviśeṣoktānanyān nyāsān samācaret śāstradṛṣṭena vinyasenmantravittataḥ mantrī kuryāddigbandhanaṃ sudhīḥ dhyātveṣṭadevatārūpamātmānamathapūjayet kusumairartryā (rcā) sāttvikī sāśubhā matā tasmātsarvaprayatnena mānasaṃ pūjanaṃ śubham cāntarvaiśvadevaṃ samācaret tryaste mūlamantrapurassaram juhomi śivarūpataḥ pratyekaṃ juhuyāttataḥ proktaḥ suṣumnā sragudīritā sarvasampattyai guhyetyādi samarpayet vijñāneśvarasiddānte tvanyathāmārcaneritā tadevasyādarghādi trayamuttamam sekakriyā snāna miheṣyate bhavedgandhaḥ saparyāsu maheśvari puṣpapūjāsyādiha kathyate samarpayetsamantāttau manuvit sthiramānasaḥ syātsarvasya nivedyaṃ prītidāyakam

nṛtyamajñatvadhi * * * gītaṃ vāk paripūrṇatā sampannamityāhuḥ sāmpradāyikāḥ gandhapuṣpākṣatayavakuśāgratilasarṣapaiḥ prakṣālyavāmato vahnimaṇḍale pratilomena mūlānte mātṛkāṃ japan toyairāpūrayecchuddhaiḥ yogaśāstraviśāradaḥ paṭhantyeva vidhāne mātṛkāmanoḥ cintayitvā kalāsteṣāṃ tatra tatra vicintayet divākarakalātmānaṃ tathā vai bhānumaṇḍalam vijñeyamaṃ dvitīyaṃ prakīrtitam āvāhayettatto mantrī tīrthamaṅkuśamudrayā sannidhiṃkuru madhyamāṃ kṛtvā tarjanīmadhyaparvaṇi tatreṣṭa devatāṃ mantrī svīyahṛtkamalādapi kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakau saktau karayoritaretaram proktā śaṅkhasyoparicālitā surabhermūlamantreṇa mantrayetsalilaṃ tataḥ avaguṇḍanamudreyamabhito bhrāmitā matā madhyā dhenumudrā samīritā gandhādyairhṛdā tatreṣṭadevatām saṃspṛśannaṣṭavāraṃ mūlaṃ japettataḥ śaṃkha saṃskaraṇe matā kiñcidarghāmbu dattvātra hastenāṅgāni cātmanaḥ ādhāre gaṇapaṃ yajet hṛdaye madhye bhruvo mūlamanoryajet

tattatkalpaviśeṣokta prakārānyantavigraham mantrī tattatkalpaprakāśitam gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ bindusrutasudhārasaiḥ japenmantraṃ yathākṣaṇam bījamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet praṇavasaṃpuṭam saṃhitāyāṃ tu proktamāvaraṇārcanam deveśaṃ parivārāṁśca pūjayet tataḥ kuryāddai(dai) hikābhyudayāya vai mānena nāpyanuktirnivedanāt prokṣaṇītoyaṃ salilaiḥ paripūrayet pādyaṃ kāryamācamanīyakam śaṃkhaṃ pūrvataḥ susamāhitaḥ pātre pādyādīni prakalpayet tāmraṃ kāṃkṣyaṃ pālāśapatrakam pātramaṣṭavidhaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ param ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulīpātramuttamaṃ parikīrtitam vasvaṅgulivihīnaṃ tu na pātraṃ kārayetkvacit gandhākṣatādikaṃ mantrī sādhanaṃ sakalaṃ nyaset likhedyantrarājaṃ tattatkalpoktarūpavat devaḥ prīṇāti pūjitaḥ tāmre pīṭhe bhūrje paṭe bhuvi kalpe tadā bhūpurasaṃyutam vidhinālikhya pūjayediṣṭadevatām pūjādhāratayoktatvādāvaśyakamihocyate madhyabhāge tataḥ sampūjayedbudhaḥ

ādhāraśaktiṃ prayajetpaṅkajadvayadhāriṇīm samāsīnaṃ kūrmaṃ nīlābhamarcayet mūrdhni dhārayantaṃ vasundharām abhyarcayedvasumatīṃ sphuratsāgaramekhalām pūjayetteṣāṃ vedikāṃ maṇḍalojjvalām vṛṣakesaribhūtebharūpān dharmādhikān bhajet koṇeṣu dikṣu cāthāmbujaṃ yajet pañcāśadvarṇabījāḍhyāṃ karṇikāṃ ca prapūjayet padmapūjanamūcire sauraṃ saṃpūjya taṃ tāpinyādi tatkalāḥ (uṣa)rbudhaṃ tṛtīyena dhūmrārciḥ prabhṛtīḥ kalāḥ rajastamaḥ proktā ādibījaiḥ samarcayet yathāvidhi samarcayet tathā madhye śaktīrnaṃva yathākramam kalpoktairathavā mantrairmūlamuccārya sādhakaḥ kalpasaṃproktarūpāṃ dhyāyettataḥ param proktaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā nirguṇaṃ dhyānamiti brahmavido viduḥ somasūryāgnimaṇḍalena virājitam taddhi saguṇaṃ dhyānamucyate tattejaḥ suṣumnāvartmanā śive nāsikārandhramārgeṇa nirgataṃ sumanoharam brahmarandhreṇa mūrtau tasyāṃ vidhānataḥ samyak saṃsthāpanākhyamudrayā nirodhinyā sammukhīkṛtya mudrayā

paścādavaguṇṭhanamudrayā baddhvā vidadhyāt paramīkṛtim baddhvānāmikāmūlaparvaṇoḥ tviyaṃ cetsyātsthāpinī mudrikā matā praveśitāṅguṣṭhā saiva saṃbo(ro)dhinī matā ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ nyāsaḥ syātsakalīkṛtiḥ grathitāṅguṣṭhā prasārita parāṅguliḥ devatāhvānakarmaṇi tu nityaṃ sannihito hariḥ tattvarūpasya tejasaḥ siddhāntasārīyavacanasyānurodhataḥ śivasyāvāhitasyāsya vidyāddehe'tra sannidhim prapūjyamānāṃ tu gṛhītvā nigrahādikam pūjāyāṃ tānnidhyaṃ hi śivasya yat vyāptaṃ dhyeyaṃ syādavaguṇṭhanam sārdhamamṛtīkaraṇaṃ matam āvāhanādikāryāṇāmayamarthaḥ prakāśitaḥ kesarāḥ pañcavargeṇa yaśanā (lā)rṇādikairapi nāstānāṅgalinaujñeyātadvat kṣoṇīpurasya vai p. 95) mātṛkāmbhojamākhyātaṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇam sthāne sve sve mantryupaveśayet samuccārya pīṭhaṃ tasyai nivedayet syāt kvaca (kvāci) tkovā niyāmakaḥ deyaṃ kathaṃ syādeṣa nirṇayaḥ niyamayatyekā parā sākalyabodhikā

dātavyaṃ jalamityavagamyate viśiṣṭo nāsticenmanuḥ samuccaredayaṃ mantro mūlādiḥ parikīrtitaḥ mūrdhni śiromantreṇa saṃskṛtam śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntājalairmatam jātīlavaṅgakakkolaistaduktaṃ mantravedibhiḥ saṃproktaṃ vikalpastvanayordvayoḥ mantrānnamonvitāneva taduktaṃ tatra mantribhiḥ saramuccārya pādyādīni prakalpayet nama iti procya dadyātpādyaṃ ca pādayoḥ syātpunastasyoccāraṇārthamidaṃ vacaḥ camanīyaṃ ca trivāraṃ mukhapaṅkaje svadhetyārādhyacaraṇāḥ pradīpe vyaktamūcire dadhimadhūnmiśraṃ madhuparkaḥ samīritaḥ godhūmā vrīhīṇāmiva śālayaḥ dadyādabbhirācamanīyakam abhyaṅgodvartanaṃ kuryānmahārājopacāravat keśāngamārjanaṃ vastraṃ dattvā sūkṣme dukūlake saṃsthāpyamaṇḍale ramye divyamālyānulepanaiḥ mantrī tattatkalpaprakāśitam malayotpannamanāghrātaṃ suśītalam puṭitairmātṛkākṣaraiḥ uttamāṅgahṛdādhārapādasarvāṅgakaiḥ kramāt karavīre dve kumude tulasīdvayam kundamandārapuṃnāga pāṭalānāga campakam

sakoraṇṭaṃ palāśāśokamallikāḥ sugandhīni puṣpapatrāṇi sādhakaḥ bhūmisaṃspṛṣṭaṃ kṛmikeśādi dūṣitam mastakaṃ kuryātkusumopahitaṃ sadā pūjāyāṃ kusumāñjalipañcake dadyātpādadvandve vidhānavit dadyātparivārānathārcayet ṣaḍbhirapītyuktermūrdhnisyādañjalidvayam prathamatā teṣāṃ kvacidevānyathā bhavet dikṣucāstramaṅgamantrairnamo'ntakaiḥ pūjane gārgyasaṃhitā sphaṭikaśyāmanīlakṛṣṇāruṇatviṣaḥ viduṣā'nena krameṇaivāṅgadevatāḥ virahāt sandeho'tra vijāyate jñeyāḥ pūjāhomādikarmaṇi syāttatraivaṃ dikprakalpanā mantriṇaḥ prāhurapare tu samantataḥ paścādabhyarcanāyāḥsyuḥ kalpoktā vṛttayaḥ kramāt hetijātyādhipopetānanthathā kaścidicchati vajrahastāya surādhipataye padam caivamanyeṣāṃ vāhanādikamuddharet yakṣo varuṇaḥ pavano vidhuḥ rakto'sito dhūmraḥ śuklo dhūmrasitāvubhau gauroruṇaḥ kramādete varṇataḥ parikīrttitāḥ padmameṣāmāyudhāni kramādviduḥ

pāṭalābhā vajrādyāḥ parikīrttitāḥ airāvatastathā meṣo mahiṣaḥ pretasaṃjñakaḥ kramādeṣāṃ vāhanāni vidurbudhāḥ vikalpenānvito bhavet ihāṅgendravajrādyaiḥ pūjayediṣṭadevatām prakurvīta tāmrakāṃsyādinirmite sārāṅgāraviniḥkṣiptairguggulvaguruvṛkṣajaiḥ ananyārpitadhūpo'yaṃ śasyate'rcanakarmaṇi pradīptaśca vartyā gavyaghṛtāktayā śāradāyāmatispaṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ dhūpadīpayoḥ dhūpayedājyasaṃmiśrairnīcairdevasya deśikaḥ darśayeddīpānuccaiḥ saurabhaśālinaḥ pradānārthaṃ prārthayediṣṭa devatām naivedyaṃ mṛdu soṣṇaṃ supācitam kadalīpanasāmrādi dadhi dugdhaṃ prapānakam astrokṣitaṃ cakramudrārakṣitaṃ vāyuvāriṇā sudhādhārāpūrṇaṃ mūlāmṛtīkṛtam amṛtīkṛtya gandhādyairnaivedyamatha pūjayet svāhāntaṃ mūlamuccārya jalaṃ dattvā nivedayet sarvārcāsu nijākhyayā vāmadoṣṇā vikacotpatrasannibhām kaniṣṭhikānāme aṅguṣṭhaśirasā spṛśet madhyātarjanyanāmikāḥ vyānodānasamānāstārapūrvikāḥ prāṇādikā mudrā darśanīyāḥ krameṇa vai

kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakau yuktau mudraiṣā cakrasaṃjñitā nijāṃ manuṃ japan pradarśayet cābhāṣya nivedyaṃ kalpayāmi ca piṣṭakasaṃjātān samavartisamanvitān pārāvatabhramākārānatidīptisamanvitān proktaṃ ghaṇṭāvādanapūrvakam vidhivadvidvān vaiśvadevaṃ samācaret tāravyāhṛtibhirhutvā mūlamantreṇa mantravit punarvyāhṛtibhirdattvā gandhādyaiḥ punararcayet avaśiṣṭena haviṣā vikiret parito balim homasaṃkhyādviguṇaṃ japamācaret vākyānusāreṇa sarvatrāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ puraskriyāṅgavaiguṇyapravṛttiṃ naiva gacchati vacananyāyasaṅkoco niṣpramāṇakaḥ bhūtaśuddhyādau tvetacchiṣṭairna sammatam karaṇe śaraṇībhavet cullukodakamamṛtāpidhānamasi ṭhadvayam naivedyaṃ tataścaitatsamuddharet viṣvakṛsenaḥ smṛto viṣṇostejaścaṇḍo vivaśvataḥ gaṇapaterabhī ucchiṣṭabhojinaḥ tuṇḍavāsakaṃ mālyabhūṣaṇam tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet prayaccheta puṣpāñjalimananyadhīḥ pārṣadārcāyāṃ vivadante'tra kecana syurato neha bahūcyate

viṣṇoḥ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam padābhyāṃ jānubhyāmurasā vacasā dṛśā syātpūjāsu pravarāvimau hṛtsthā saivāsane bhavet svāgatasvastikā mudrā madhyāmūlagalā (tā)ṅguliḥ hastau pādyamudrā samīritā madhyamāstisro mudrācāme prakīrttitā tu sā mudrā saṃkalpya kalasaṃ kare prasāritāstisro mudrā vastrasya kīrttitā yajñopavītamudreyaṃ kathitā vedapāragaiḥ nirnāmikāmuṣṭirgandhamudreti kīrtitā samākhyātā puṣpadānavivardhinī dhūpapradāne syād devānāṃ tuṣṭikāriṇī pañcāṅgulyagrasaṃlagnā grathitordhvamukhī yadi praṇāme tāṃ vinirdiśet brahmārpaṇākhyamanunā kuryādbrahmārpaṇakriyām cāha mantradevaprakāśikā devatā haste manunānena cārpayet me mātastvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvari rājñāmupacāraiḥ pratoṣayet dhyātvā puṣpakṣepeṇa kalpayet pūrṇatetyāha nāradaḥ tattaddevastavaiḥ stutvā taṃ taṃ devaṃ yathāvidhi tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā tāvat kṣamasva tvaṃ dayānidhe

pūjā bhūyātdbhūyai ca me prabho karuṇāhetoḥ kṣantavyamayamañjaliḥ sarvamupasaṃhāramudrayā kṣiptvāṅgulīraṅgulibhiḥ saṃyojya parivartayet vadanmūla mantreṇa vyāpakaṃ triśaḥ puṣpamāghrāyodvāsayetsudhīḥ kṛtvā saptavāraṃ mantraṃ mūlaṃ japetsudhīḥ devārcanāvaśiṣṭaṃ yat salilaṃ śaṅkhamadhyagam mastake dhāryaṃ sarvāṅge cānulepanam gandhādyairmānasairiṣṭvā ṛṣyādinyāsapūrvakam vidhinā bhaktimān sthiramānasaḥ ityāhodvāsanasyānte puraścaraṇa candrikā kiñcidāpnoti kleśamātraṃ hi tasya tat suviśuddhena bhāvena tadānantyāya kalpate tadgṛhṇantyasurāstasya gū (mū)ḍhasya dṛṣkṛtātmanaḥ yathānyāyaṃ yathālokāvigarhitam madhyamaireva nyūno hīnaiḥ samācaret dravyaśuddhisamāyuktamuttamaṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet madhyamaṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet puṣpayāgaṃ tu kaniṣṭhaṃ pūjanaṃ hi tat devatāmātraṃ dhyātvā samyak prapūjayet bāhyāṃ pūjāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ śaknoti kuryādarcanadarśanam kuryattadaniṣṭaphalaṃ śrutau tasya durmaterjāyate phalam

citproktamakṛtvāmānasārcanam tvetanna (vā) taddevatātmatām proktaṃ vinyāse mātṛkā manoḥ pūjāṃ vakṣyābhyāgamabodhitām bāhyapūjākrameṇaiva dhyānayogena pūjayet kuryāddevatārcanam yo'rcayedvidhivadbhaktyā parānītaiśca sādhanaiḥ samagraṃ phalaṃ labhet hyetaduttamaṃ prārthitārthadam tena taiḥ sārdhaṃ tatphalaṃ bhavet gauṇamārādhitaṃ tena pādamātraphalaṃ bhavet taṃ yastu niṣphalaṃ tasya pūjanam sarveṣāmīpsitārthānāmanyathā cettathā nahi yāti bhaktayā kurvannapi dvijaḥ japadaśāṃśena homaṃ kuryāddine dine lakṣasaṃkhyāyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ homamācaret daśāṃśataḥ kuryāt svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaran mantreṇoṅkārapūtena svāhāntena vicakṣaṇaḥ sarveṣu svāhāntatvaṃ vyavasthitam cinmatamajñānagāḍhāntardhvāntasaṅgatam bhavedetadekayaiva kimanyayā adṛṣṭārthakatāpattāvanyathā gauravaṃ bhavet svāhāmatiriktāṃ samarthitaḥ viśiṣṭaṃ ca vākyamapyanupaṭhyate etadādyeṣu mantreṣu praṇavaṃ naiva yojayet

ṭhadvayānte ṭhadvayaṃ na namo'nte na namo vadet samālokya saṃhitāḥ śāradādikam mantrī tadvidhānaṃ pravakṣyate sthaṇḍile kāmyahomasya na vidhiḥ kvacit karttavyaḥ sādhakaistatra kutracit gurvādīnnatvā bhūtaviśodhanam tattvanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva prāṇasaṃyamam ekahastaṃ prakurvīta caturaṅgulamucchritam vālukābhiścaturasraṃ samantataḥ mūlamantreṇa śareṇa prokṣaṇaṃ matam likhellekhā hṛdā prāgudagagragāḥ rekhāṇāmudagagrāṇāṃ brahmavaivasvatendavaḥ likhedrekhāḥ svaśākhoktā iti yallaghudīpikā barhiḥ syāttenedamiti kaścana sakesaraṃ tvaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tato bahiḥ śaktimālikhya madhye sadhakasattamaḥ mantrārṇaiḥ śaktibījābhito likhet pūrvaṃ kaumodaki tato bhavet varmāstrāntāni nijamantrāṇi vai kramāt mahāśūlaṃ tataḥ param vāgīśvarīpīṭhaṃ tato mantrī prapūjayet bhuvaneśvaryāḥ śaktīḥ pīṭhamanuṃ tathā dogdhrī aghorā maṅgalā nava pīṭhamantro'yamāvāhyāsmin prapūjayet vāgīśvareṇasahitāmupacārairanukramāt

tattvasāgara saṃhitādiṣu pūjayet saṃjātamāgniṃ tatra vicintayet sūryakāntādisambhūtaṃ yadvā śrotriyagehajam kiñcidaṅgāramādāya kavacāṇunā kravyādāṃśaṃ tyajāmīti kecittyāgamihocire audaryavaindavāgnibhyāmaikyaṃ saṃbhāvayanavasoḥ dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtam paribhrāmya pradakṣiṇamatandritaḥ vahniṃ jānuspṛṣṭamahītalaḥ śivavīryadhiyā devyā yonāvenaṃ viniḥkṣipet niḥkṣipya vidhivaddagdhvāsmin homakarmaṇi mantrī vahnerdakṣiṇataḥ kuśe kalpayedetānyaśaktau sādhakottamaḥ puṣpacandanatāmbūlasahitaṃ vāsasāṃ trayam tābhyāṃ dadyādācamanīyakam samprokṣya yonimācchādya satkuśaiḥ garbharakṣārthaṃ mūlamantrābhimantritam garbhiṇīṃ śaktiṃ rakṣa rakṣeti coccaran proktaṃ tatraiva tadihocyate kṛtvā tanmadhyeṅguṣṭhakau kṣipet jvālayenmanunānena tamagnimatha sādhakaḥ sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā] kuryādagnidhamanaṃ kuryācca vyajanādinā yaccoktaṃ laukike yojayanti tat prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutāśanam

trividhā rasanā vasoḥ prāṇanetreṣu sarvataḥ mantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā jihvānāṃ sapta ca kramāt tataḥ śvetā dhūminī ca karālikā kṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matā viśvamūrtisphuliṅginyo dhūmravarṇā manojavā divyapūjāsu rājasyaḥ kāmyakarmasu sapitṛgandharvayakṣanāgapiśācakāḥ karāṅgavinyāsāvebhirmantrairyathā purā saptajihvo dhanurdhara itīritāḥ tanau tadvadātmano jātavedasaḥ prakṣiṇakramānnyasyeducyante tā yathā kramāt saṃjño'nyastathā vaiśvānarāhvayaḥ padādyāḥ syurnamo'ntā vahnimūrtayaḥ sampūjayenmantrī navaśakti samanvitam jvālinī proktāḥ kṛśānornavaśaktayaḥ varaśaktisvastyabhītīrdadhānaṃ karapallavaiḥ jihvābhirvakṣyamāṇābhiryuktaṃ karmasu taṃ kramāt hiraṇyeśe kṛṣṇā rakṣasi nīlaruk taruṇārkaprabhā padmarāgaprakhyā jale sthitā ca dakṣottaranivāsinī hiraṇyā'karṣaṇādau syāt kanakā stambhanādiṣu gaditā śāntā tūccāṭe cātiraktikā madhye tanotīti na saṃśayaḥ darbhairagabhairmadhyasthamekhalāyāṃ paristaret

bhaṭṭanāgena tripurāsārasaṃgrahe paridhīn prācivarjaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ekavṛkṣasamudbhūtānārdrānati-ṛjūn śubhān gṛhṇīyāt pūrvābhāve paraṃ param ca koṇeṣu jihvā bījādikā yajet pūjayenmūrttīḥ śaktisvastikadhāriṇīḥ paścādādāya pāṇibhyāṃ sruksu (sru) vau tāvadhomukhau tadagramūlamadhyāni śodhayettairyathākramam pratāpayenmantrī darbhānagnau viniḥkṣipet ājyasthālīmathādāya prokṣayedastravāriṇā viniḥkṣipya saṃskṛtaṃ vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ tāpanamuddiṣṭaṃ sādhakaistantrakovidaiḥ hṛdayamantreṇa pavitrīkaraṇaṃ tvidam visarjayeddarbhamabhidyotanamīritam tānnyasyet pradyotanamidaṃ matam aṅguṣṭhopakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ darbhau prādeśa sammitau tadvaddhṛdayamantreṇa kuśābhyāmātmasaṃmukham prādeśamātraṃ sagranthi darbhayugmaṃ ghṛtāntare nāḍīmiḍāṃ bhāge sakṣiṇe piṅgalāṃ tataḥ dakṣiṇādbhāgādādāyājyaṃ hṛdā budhaḥ vāmatastadvadādāya vāme vahnivilocane vahnerbhālavilocane trinetrasadbhāvo vidyate nṛhariṃ vinā vahnestrinetratvaṃ devatāpekṣamucyate sruveṇājyaṃ bhāgādādāya dakṣiṇāt

bhāgeṣvājyasyādvā (dyā) hutikramāt kramādbhāgatrayādājyaṃ sruveṇādāya sādhakaḥ ityagnivaktranetrāṇāṃ kuryādudghāṭanaṃ budhaḥ īśatatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmasvarūpiṇaḥ mantrī nityahomaṃ samācaret pākaśuddhau ca vāme homaṃ samācaret iṣṭasañjananārthaṃ tu prācīnavadane yajet tu tatraiva pañcame tu vimuktaye satārābhirvyāhṛtibhirājyena juhuyāttataḥ garbhādhānādikā vahneḥ kriyā nirvarttayetkramāt tu mūlena garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥ saptāhutīrdattvā garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tataḥ paścādannaprāśanamīritam paniṣadaṃ paścād godānodvāhakau mṛtiḥ samuddiṣṭā vahnerāgamavedibhiḥ godānāntetyataḥ proktaṃ samāvartanamucyate ājyāhutyaṣṭakairdattvā nāmakarma tathaiva ca tasya saṃpūjyātmani yojayet śleṣmātāpiśācatarusamudbhūtāḥ parityajet śleṣmātāpiśācataruṃ tyaktvā'nyebhyastu tāṃ haret juhuyādekāmāhutiṃ mantravittamaḥ kecinmūlamanoraṅgamantrāṃstantrārthavedinaḥ sampradāyo'traśaraṇaṃ na kiñcidavaśiṣyate tiṣṭhannevāgnau sādhako yatamānasaḥ

mantreṇa juhuyādāhutīrdaśa sarvamantrāṇāmetadagnimukhaṃ matam arcayedagnirūpāṃ tāṃ devatāmiṣṭadāyinīm mūlamantraiṇa vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ smṛtam juhuyādājyenaikādaśāhutīḥ juhuyādaṅgamukhyānāmāhutīnāmanukramāt tatastrimadhuropetaistilairvā kalpadeśitaiḥ mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ kuryādatha homaṃ vidhānavit pṛthivyai ca mahate ca samanvitam mahāvyāhṛtayastvetāḥ sarvaśo devatāmayāḥ vyāhṛtibhiḥ proktā mahāvyāhṛtayo yathā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyānmūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ ājyena sruvamāpūrya tenāpūrya srucaṃ tataḥ ṛjukāyastayormūlaṃ nābhimūle nidhāya ca phalapuṣpākṣatopetamavichinnājyadhārayā śrīsomaśambhunā proktaṃ sampūrṇāhuti lakṣaṇam puṣpamāropya paścādvāmena pāṇinā samaṅgatordhvakāyaśca samapādaḥ samanvitaḥ durgādikāraṇatyāgādviniḥsṛtya suṣumnayā mūlamantramatasyordhvaṃ vauṣaḍantaṃ samuddharet brahmārpaṇākhyamanunā punaraṣṭāvathāhutīḥ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārataḥ vācā karmaṇā ca prabhāṣayet yat smṛtaṃ coktvā yaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tathā dvicā (ṭhā) ntoyaṃ brahmārpaṇamanurmataḥ

proktavidhānena jihvādīnāṃ vibhāvasoḥ yojayitvā sve paridhīn saparistarān paścānmaṇḍale balimāharet dadyādbaliṃ gandhapuṣpadhūpapūrvakamādarāt meṣādimuktvā nakṣatrasaṃjñāpūrvamanantaram cāribhyaścātha sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaśca namo vadet rāśyadhipānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ tatra tatra tu balistvevaṃ samprokto homakarmaṇi caturasraṃ ca tadvidaḥ pipīlikākārā mātuluṅganibhā api paṅkajadalanibhā vā kathitā budhaiḥ bṛhaspatirmanda śanigīṣpatayaḥ kramāt sitaścaiva haritaḥ pāṭalastathā vabhruḥmalino rucibhiḥ kramāt mānavastadvat kaulavastaittirastathā vidhivanmantrī devatāṃ paripūjayet proktamagnimukhaṃ mantrī nityahome'pi yojayet nityātkāmyavidherbhedaḥ sarvatraiva hi dṛśyate kimanyaiḥ śāradādike śeṣānanujñāphalako nāto garbhādikā kriyā homavidhiṃ coktvā śeṣe yacchāradādike paridherviśeṣaḥ kevalo mataḥ viśeṣastena homayoḥ kāmye'pyetadagnimukhaṃ matam tataḥ kuryāt kāmya homamanantaram

nitye'pītyavagantavyaṃ yacca vaiśeṣiko vidhiḥ proktaṃ na tu vaiśeṣiko vidhiḥ] homasya vyāhṛtyorvādvayoḥ svakāt nāstāñca nāḍī sandhānaṃ pratipakṣaśiraḥ svidam saṃskāraśabdasya vīkṣaṇādi catuṣṭaye evāstāmanukalpe dva (tva)yaṃ vidhiḥ ādhānapūrvakālatvādvīkṣaṇādeḥ śrutakrame bhūyāttanmūlāntarakalpane nirvāhādapi cādhānakarmaṇaḥ tatra mantrapātrasamanvayaḥ saṃskāraśabdārthaścatvāro vīkṣaṇādayaḥ bhaṭṭanāgenāpyamunā tu susaṃskṛte tadarthadvārabodhanāt bhavedetannityeṣu na dahedimān tasmādetadvadhūmāṣamāpanenopamīyate vahnisaṃskāraḥ sarvasādharaṇo mayā kāmye puraścaraṇakarmaṇi vidhāyādau sāmānyārghaṃ vidhāya ca mūlamantreṇa saṃśodhya saṃskārairvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ vidhinā kṣiptvā prajvālya bodhayet saṃpūjya brahmādīnagnimarcayet samidho'gnau ghṛtāhuti catuṣṭayam āhutibhirghṛtairhutvā yathāvatsādhakottamaḥ taddevatāṃ vahnau vidhinā pūjayedapi daśāṃśamaṅgeṣu dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ

japaṃ kuryuścaturguṇam kecittu homasaṃkhyāyāścāturguṇyamihocire saṃhitāderaśaktānāmityādau dīpikodite viśiṣṭavidhigauravāt sa home kāmateritā śaktyapekṣo'yaṃ vikalpo homapakṣataḥ guravo'pyamumarthamavādiśan prakṛtatvena na tu jāpadaśāṃśataḥ dīpikāvākyagocaraḥ japaḥ śūdre proktastannaviśāradaiḥ kuryātāṃ homamityapaceṣṭatā pauraścaraṇake vidhau tadaprāptiḥ sahomake syādvirodhaḥ prakṛte bhavet cāmnāyamantrāṇāṃ sādhye syādadhikāritā anyathaivopapatteśca pūjāhomo (me)'pi sā bhavet mantraṃ na taṃ pūjā yadā bhavet evāstu puraścaraṇakarmaṇaḥ syādyadā home tayordvayoḥ mūḍhavikrītagavāṃ rakṣaṇamucyate japāddhomāt śālagrāmaśilārcanāt trayāṇāmeva varṇānāṃ home vidhirudīritaḥ vāyavīsaṃhitā'pyāha sphuṭamarthamimaṃ yathā tathaiva śūdrānāṃ praśasyeta na haumikī tadā tatrāstu kā kṣatiḥ

yadyaśaktiḥ syāddhome vā tarpaṇe'pi vā dvayenaiva puraścaraṇa karma vai sāṅgasiddhyarthaṃ tadaśaktena bhaktitaḥ ca saṃkhyā noktā manīṣibhiḥ saṃkhyānuktau śataṃ sāṣṭaṃ sahasraṃ vā daśāpi vā saṃmohane proktamanukte kāmyakarmaṇaḥ gauravānmantrī tattaddhomaṃ samācaret caitaduktaṃ prātyahike jape agastyasaṃhitāyāmapyeṣa vaiśeṣiko vidhiḥ nāsti na vā prahvādikalpanam syādityapekṣāyāmucyate munibhāṣitam vijñeyaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāragaḥ karaḥ proktā aindrī saumyāparājitā kartavyaṃ na prahvena na tiṣṭhatā tarpayettaddaśāṃśena vidyānandakṛtāgame tripurāsārasaṃgrahe'pi prakīrttitam vakṣye sampradāyānusārataḥ jalenaiva pīṭhamantrāntamādarāt homāddaśāṃśato devavadane salilaiḥ śubhaiḥ yojyaṃ mantrānte sveṣu nāmasu tarpaṇaṃ vidadhīta vai vidhānena daśāṃśaṃ śuddhavāriṇā saṃkhyāyāṃ budhastvekaikamañjalim kecidicchanti parivārasya tarpaṇam padāttarpayāmi namo'ntataḥ

daśāṃśena mārjayedātmamūrdhani dhyātasyātmano mūrdhni sādhakaḥ mūlamuccārya kuryāditi cirantanāḥ vakṣye tanmatasyānusārataḥ samāvāhyāsanaṃ dattvā mūlenaiveṣṭadevatām pādyādyairarcayediṣṭadevatārūpabhūsurān tatsāṅgaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet bhojayedvidvān kṛtasāṅgārthasiddhaye viduṣo bhojayet sarvakarmasu syuḥ pathi rājñāṃ gajā iva japamātrasya daśāṃśādeva cintanam vidhāyetthaṃ samyak sādhaka sattamaḥ bahubhirvastrabhūṣābhiḥ pūjayedgurumātmanaḥ dīnānāthāṃśca santoṣya mantrāḥ siddhyantimantriṇām snātvā saṃyatamānasaḥ kuśākṣatajalaiḥ kuryāt saṃkalpaṃ devatāntataḥ sparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ pūjāṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇatarpaṇam mantrasya jāyate siddhiruttamā syātpauraścaraṇake vidhau dakṣiṇāmūrtimantre taditi tāntrikāḥ tāvatpuraskriyāṃ kuryādyāvatsiddho bhavenmanuḥ puṃso viniyogamajānataḥ saṃhitādau yat prayogaḥ pratiṣidhyate prayogavidhiśeṣataḥ

tathā lakṣmaṇamanoḥ kintu yāti parāṃ gatim māraṇādirudāhṛtaḥ prayogakartṝṇāṃ paraloko na vidyate bhaviṣyatītyanyatarabādhāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyati svīkāryaṃ niṣiddha viṣayaṃ hi tat nānāvidhavacobādhābhayena parikalpyate yatastadanyathābhūtaṃ tata eva samāpayet kuryānnāvṛttiḥ sarvakarmaṇaḥ tadaṅgasyākriyā (yāntu) santu nāvṛttirnaiva tatkriyā śrameṇāpi naiva siddhiḥ samīhitā siddhaikamantrasya nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kvacit vīrasādhanāṃ susamāhitaḥ tasmātsarvaprayatnena kartavyā vīrasādhanā parataraṃ kiñcidvidyate śīghrasiddhidam lokoktyā tadvidhānamanuttamam samutpādya madhumāṃsaguḍaudanaiḥ sārdhayāmottaraṃ niśi dūre dṛṣṭvā dhṛtvā kiyati paścime ācamyāñjalimābaddhya mantramenaṃ japetsudhīḥ me siddhiṃ mamatvenānukampayā citādvāracatuṣke taccatuṣṭayam śmaśānaṣambha imaṃ sāmiṣānnabaliṃ vadet prayaccheti svāhānteti manurmataḥ ityuktvā imamityādiko paraḥ imamityādikastvanyo dakṣiṇasyāṃ manurmataḥ

mantraḥ syāttato'nena nivedayet (maṃ) baliṃ mātardehi me siddhimuttamām prāṇāyāmādikaṃ kuryāttato dhyātveṣṭa devatām ekākṣare'yutaṃ jāpo dvyākṣare'(ṣṭa) sahasrakam saṃkhyoktā japānte devatā yadi chāgabaliṃ dattvā varaṃ samprārthayedbudhaḥ pañcavatsarādūrdhvama (ṣṭo)rddhvamiti kaścana catuṣpathe tīre nadyā vā mṛtakaṃ budhaḥ vidhivatsveṣṭa devatām dadyācchāgabalintvante bhairave'nāmikā matā gaṇeśe tu madhyānyatra yatheṣṭa (ccha) yā munibhirdaivataiścaiva kathitaṃ sādhakepsitam kathito'yamavekṣakaḥ tataḥ prayogān kurvīta sādhako nijavāñchitān saṃkṣepānnānātantrānusārataḥ pañcagavyāni tatsamānaṃ manīṣibhiḥ syāttathā madhviti kecana madhudugdhāderbhavecculukamātratā sruvālābhe nityahomādikarmaṇi kecidityāhuḥ sāmpradāyikāḥ pṛthukāstatpramāṇāḥ syuḥ saktavo'pi tathoditāḥ carumānaṃ syādikṣuḥ parvāvadhirmataḥ kadalīphalanāraṅgaphalānyekaikaśo viduḥ mātuluṅgānītyevaṃ kecidihocire phalaṃ bailvaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhā

phalānyanyāni khaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṅgulāḥ tvacā caiva na sakīṭā na pāṭritā saparṇā na nirvīryā homeṣu ca vijānatā vidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sasuṣirāstathā śrīsomaśambhurapyāha pramāṇaṃ mūlakādiṣu grāsārdhamātramannānāmakṣāṇi pañcahomayet bhāgaṃ juhuyādvidhinā param muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgamāṣayavā api karṣamātrāḥ syuḥ saptāṣṭau vā yavā matāḥ ścana raktakalamā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥ rājamāṣamitāḥ proktā ityanye tantravedinaḥ proktāḥ karṣārdhārdhāstu sarṣapāḥ śuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ marīcānyekaviṃśatiḥ caturaṅguṣṭhamānaṃ syādvyañjanaṃ kṛśaraṃ tathā candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṅkumāni ca proktaṃ pramāṇaṃ candanādiṣu kastūrīkuṅkumāni ca havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyate sahasraṃ syaddravyānukto ghṛtaṃ tathā dakṣiṇāmūrtitantre tu prāhaitadgārgyasaṃhitā smṛtidṛṣṭena vartmanā samitpuṣpaphalādīnāṃ kartavyo mṛgamudrayā militvānāmikāṅguṣṭhamadhyamāgrāṇi yojayet sthitaṃ dhyāyet samiddhomeṣu sādhakaḥ

bhavedvyādhiḥ netre'ndhatvamudīritam prakurvīta mukhe nityaṃ vibhāvasoḥ yatrālpajvalanaṃ netraṃ yatrāṅgārastataḥ śiraḥ kṣuttṛṭakrodhatvarāyukto hīnamantrairjuhoti yaḥ rūkṣe sasphuliṅge vāmāvartte bhayānake sudurgandhe phūtkāravati pāvake juhotyagnau vya * vini ca mānavaḥ śriyamātyantikīṃ tathā varṇaḥ śobhanaḥ parikīrttitaḥ punnāga pāṭalāyūthikānibhaḥ ityuktaṃ tantravedibhiḥ śubhadā yajamānasya rāṣṭrasyāpi viśeṣataḥ rogakaro nityaṃ raupyābho rāṣṭrahānidaḥ kharavāyasasaṃrāva sadṛśo dhvaniriṣṭahā balahāniṃ svedābhaḥ śubhanāśakaḥ kuryānmṛtyuṃ dhanaparikṣayam turagajātīnāṃ gavāṃ ca kurute cirāt kṛśānorhomakālesyādanarthamaśubhodayaḥ juhuyātpañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā sādhakavaraścakrapūjāṃ samācaret prāyaścittamidaṃ proktaṃ tripurāsārasaṃgrahe pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣaste suvarṇastu ṣoḍaśa dvārtriśatpalakaṃ prasthaṃ svayamuktaṃ svayambhuvā rūpyamāṣaḥ syātpalāni dharaṇo daśa] rāśimānaṃ tadevasyāt khārī ṣoḍaśabhiśca taiḥ

khārīṇāṃ tritayaṃ bhāra uditaḥ śāstrataḥ kramāt daśamāṃśena hāramicchanti kecana aṣṭamuṣṭirbhavetkuñcaḥ kuñceraṣṭau tu puṣkalam puṣkalānyevaṃ pūrṇapātramathocire dviṣṭaṃ prasthaṃ pātramanukramāt bhavenmāṣaḥ te'kṣaḥ karṣastu ṣoḍaśa paribhāṣaiṣā nāgameṣūpayujyate tadupādeyamiti cāgamavedinaḥ homānusāratastacca kāmanāvaśatastathā saṃkṣepādyathāśāstraṃ prakāśyate tatphalākāṃkṣī śubhārthasiddhayaḥ kramāt samāsena kaṇṭhanābhisameṣaṇam (khalam) tasyoktā bhūridoṣā viśāradaiḥ bhavedrogī hīne dhenudhanakṣayaḥ śoko'tyadhike vittasaṃkṣayaḥ apatyadhvaṃsanaṃ proktaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yatkaṇṭhavarjitam proktāḥ kuṇḍadoṣāḥ prayatnataḥ kaṇṭhahīne syādasiddhirnyūnamekhale vidhāyādau khananādi vidhānataḥ śuddhoktaḥ sāmyakaraṇe prakāraḥ kalpyate mayā daṇḍayoragranaikaṭye'rnyastiryak madhyacihnitaḥ svasūtramaspṛśadbhāravadgurum khanettatpūrayedanyannimnayedvāpi yuktitaḥ aṅke yāvatsūtrameti bhūrevaṃ samatāṃ vrajet khātvā tu śalyoddhāraṃ tu kārayet

kalaśaṃ sārāmbuparipūritam saṃsthānaṃ yathā jñeyaṃ tadambhasā śaraṇaṃ śaṅkumṛjuṃ saṃsthāpyamadhyataḥ yatastadvaddadyāccihnaṃ dvayorapi maṇḍapādīni racayedapyatandritaḥ nakṣatravārarāśīnāmanukūle śubhe dine gandhapuṣpādyairbrāhmaṇān svasti vācayet tathā vaiśye svasti śūdre prayojayet ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ catvārasteṣu madhyagāḥ pañcahastapramāṇāste vicchidrā ṛjavaḥ śubhāḥ nārikeradalairvāṃśaiśchādayettaṃ samantataḥ caturaṣṭāṅgulādhikyāt proktaṃ madhyamapūjyayoḥ smṛtasteṣāṃ pañcaṣaṭsaptabhiḥ karaiḥ tiryakkāṣṭhaniveśārthaṃ mūrdhnicūḍāṃ niveśayet maṇḍape dvāre kīlānevaṃ prakalpayet prāgādikramayogena nyasetteṣāṃ sudārujān dairghyaṃ turīyāṃśena vistṛtiḥ caivaṃ samākhyātaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ ropayettathā nibadhnīyāllokapālasamaprabhāḥ sugandharatnamālyādiyuktāḥ kumbhāḥ prakīrttitāḥ dhvajasyeto dviguṇaṃ mānamucyate darbhamālyādyairalaṅkurvītamaṇḍapam caturasrāṃ tato vedīṃ maṇḍalāya prakalpayet madhyāṃśe pūrvādi parikalpayet yonimardhacandraṃ tryasraṃ suvartulam

ācāryakuṇḍaṃ madhye syāda gaurīpatimahendrayoḥ candrārdhaṃ māraṇe yāmye tryasraṃ dveṣetu nair-ṛte udīdīcyāṃ pauṣṭike padmaṃ raudryāmaṣṭāśri muktidam abhicāropaśāntyarthaṃ īśe saptāśri vinyaset sadā home tathāśāntāvekaṃ varuṇadiggatam ripuharaṃ tryastraṃ māraṇakārmaṇi viprāṇā rājñāṃ vartulamiṣyate caturasraṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kecidicchanti tāntrikāḥ sūtraṃ vinyaseddakṣiṇottaram sūtrāgramālambya madhyato dikcatuṣṭaye vakragatāgrāṇi tatrasūtrāṇi pātayet yāvat pramāṇaṃ kuṇḍamiṣyate yonyādikuṇḍāni tāvatkṣetramitāni ca vedonaśataṃ bhāgān nidhāya ca sūtraṃ pratīcyāṃ dakṣiṇottaram tayoḥ pārśve sāvadhānatayā sudhīḥ sūtradvaye paścāttrikoṇaṃ jāyate tataḥ vidyate tasya tvardhamānena sādhakaḥ bhavedetadanyūnānadhikaṃ śubham tataścādhaḥ sārdhabhāgadvayaṃ tyajet ṣoḍaśāṃśonaṃ muktvā tatrāpi cihnayet tataścādhaścihnamānena pūrvataḥ kuṇḍaṃ śobhanīyamidaṃ bhavet pañcabhirvardhayedagre śroṇyāḥ sūtraṃ pṛthak pṛthak pātayetteṣu cihneṣu trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamuttamam

sarvadṛṣṭimanoharam pañcanavān madhyāt tena mānena vartulam tato dadyāt ṣaḍasraṃ kuṇḍamuttamam pramāṇena karkaṭena tu madhyataḥ aṣṭamāṃśadvayenaiva madhyato bhramaṇe kṛte caturthenordhvabhūḥ kṣetranyāsatulyena ca kramāt bhāgamādāya tadbāhye pañcamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sudhīḥ vidhinā mantrī tataḥ padmaṃ samālikhet viśeṣārthaṃ khananaṃ procyate'dhunā tat kesarāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalam samyagjāyante nipuṇastathā vibhaktasya bhāgaikasya trayodaśa tāvanmānamitaṃ madhyasūtraṃ kṛtvānyadā likhet aṣṭau cihnāni kārayet saralānyaṣṭasūtrāṇi sampātānītaretaram (tryā)śca sūtrāṇi koṇāṣṭādadhikāni ca mārjayedaṣṭakoṇākhyaṃ kuṇḍametadudīritam ca yo viṃśopyaṃśastena samanvitān tāvadvyāsārdhamānena maṇḍalaṃ racayetsudhīḥ jyāsūtraṃ śeṣamānaṃ tu kṛtvā pañca prapātayet dhanūṃṣi syurjyāṣaṣṭhāṃśaśarāṇi ca jyāpañcakāvaśeṣāttu pañcāsraṃ kuṇḍamuttamam saptana (la) vāṃstasminsūtre saṃvardhya tāvatā bhāgairviṃśatyā viṃśāṃśo viśikhoyathā navabhirnavabhistvaṃśairmilitāgraṃ samantataḥ

jyāsaptakāvaśeṣāttu saptāsraṃ kuṇḍamuttamam nyunādhikatvadoṣo'stītyaṅkavit paribhāvayet kuṇḍasya vistāraḥ khananaṃ tāvadīritam tāvannimnāyataṃ khanet siddhānta upapattyāpi sidhyati ādyamekhalayā sārdhaṃ tāvadityapi kecana khanettiryak ūrddhvamekhalayā saha mantramuktāvalīgranthe'pyevameva prakīrttitam mantramuktāvalīkartustadabodhavijṛmbhitam sarveṣu mekhalāṃ racayetsudhīḥ vistāradvādaśāṃśena kecidicchanti tāntrikāḥ kuṇḍasya vardhayettatkramātsudhīḥ kāmikaikāṃśataḥ proktaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ kāmyaparastu saḥ trisro bhūtasaṃkhyā yathecchayā vibhakte tāḥ vyāse tisrastu mekhalāḥ kecidvistārataulyena hyunnatatvaṃ vadanti vai kuryātsarvatra kuṇḍeṣu tisraḥ sarvatra śobhanāḥ dvayormekhalayormānamādyormekhalayoryathā bhāgairvistāritājñeyā unnatādyā navāṅgulaiḥ connatā dvābhyāmūnaistaiśca parā matā tāsāṃ mānaṃ yattadihocyate kuṇḍe tāstithyekāṅgula sammitāḥ jñeyā rasavedaguṇāṅgulāḥ tāstu daśāṣṭārthāṅgulānvitāḥ kuṇḍe manubhānadaśāṅgulāḥ

granthe mānamuktamito'nyathā dvitīyā rājasī jñeyā mekhalāṣṭāṅgulocchritā pṛthagvistārametāsu caturaṅgulamānataḥ pūrvayāmye tu jalasthā paścimottare prāṅmukhā proktetyādāvevaṃ pratīyate yatproktaṃ sāvakāśaṃ tadanyataḥ yasmāccaturasramudāhṛtam vistṛtā tryaṃśaiścaturviṃśāṃśamānataḥ vakrāgrā jināṃśakṛtamekhalā yonikṣetrasya saṃgrāhyā mūle kumbhadvayopamā muṣṭyaratnyekahastānāṃ kuṇḍānāmathavā bhavet yonyagraṃ kuryādīṣadadhomukham nālaṃ syādyonimūlasya dhāraṇam kuryāttathā vidvān dvitīyamekhalopari tattatkuṇḍānurūpāṃ vā mānamasya (syā) nigadyate tāvadbhirāyatāpyaṃśairnābhiruktā manīṣibhiḥ kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu vardhayet tridhā kṛtvā madhye kṛtvā tu karṇikām kuryāt sampūrṇaṃ kuṇḍalakṣaṇam kuṇḍaṃ śatārdhe saṃpracakṣate caturhastamudīritam ekahastamitaṃ kuṇḍamekalakṣe vidhīyate daśalākṣācca ākoṭerdaśahastaṃ vidhīyate daśahastamitātkuṇḍānna kuṇḍaṃ tvadhikaṃ bhavet sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ budhaiḥ

kuṇḍeṣu kecidāhuriholvaṇāḥ yonyādi kuṇḍānyanyāni kārayet daśahasteti laukikaṃ hi nidarśanam ākāṃkṣāvirahādeva tvadhyāhāro na yujyate kuṇḍamityādau naiva dṛśyate kuṇḍamityādirupadeśo'yamucyate pakṣastatprakāro'tha kathayate trayastriṃśadyava saptaka saṃyutāḥ tanmānamaṅgulānekacatvāriṃśaccaturyavāḥ cāṣṭa catvāriṃśataṅgulakaṃ ca tat tanmūlamaṣṭapañcāśadaṅgulāni ca ṣaḍyavāḥ caturyavaiḥ sākaṃ triṣaṣṭiścāṅgulānyapi madhyasūtramaṣṭahastasya tūcyate saptayavaistathā atiyatnena kuṇḍāni dvikarādīni kalpayet kuṇḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyāt paramaṃ prakṛtervapuḥ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniḥ pādau tu paścime vīkṣaṇaṃ mūlamantreṇa śareṇa prokṣaṇaṃ matam khananoddhārau hṛnmantreṇa prapūraṇam hetimantreṇa varmamantreṇa mārjanam paścād hṛdayenārcanaṃ matam catuṣpathaṃ tanutreṇa tattvayā dakṣapāṭanam tāni saṃskuryāccaturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ kuṇḍādividhiratrokto dadhno ghṛtamivādarāt prakāraḥ śāstrabodhitaḥ

karturdakṣiṇahastasya madhyamāṅguli parvaṇaḥ kramādaṣṭaguṇātmakam pramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate kṛtamuṣṭikaḥ prakoṣṭho muṣṭī ratnirihocyate nāmaliṅgānāmanuśāsanasaṃgrahe syādaratniḥ sa niḥ kaniṣṭhena muṣṭinā vidyāddhastādi lakṣaṇam dairghyaṃ mātrāṅgulamudāhṛtam dairghyamānena mātrāṅgulamudāhṛtam bṛhatparvagranthibhirminuyāt sadā tu ṣaḍyavāḥ pārśvasammitāḥ madhyāṅgalīkūrparayormadhye prāmāṇikaḥ karaḥ daśatvaṅguṣṭhaparvāṇi prādeśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ siddhāntaḥ kṛto hastādikarmaṇi sākṣāddṛṣṭavedopajīvakam prapadaste (sthe) vā yaḥ syādūrdhvakareṇa vai lavoṣṭamoyavastasya proktaṃ hastādi lakṣaṇam hastamuditaṃ tat kintviti mataṃ param sarvaṃ kuryānmātrāṅgulena vai kurvīta yathāśāstraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ityāhustattvasiddhānta sārasaṃbhāravedinaḥ navānyeṣāmṛtvijāṃ vidyate kadā syādviduṣāmeva nirṇayaḥ kāraskareṣvāmalakī palāśakhadireṣvapi vibhajeddhastamātraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā punaḥ

viṃśatyaṃśairbhavedanto vedī tairaṣṭabhirbhavet vedītryaṃśena vistāraḥ kaṇṭhasya parikīritaḥ kaniṣṭhāṅgulimānena sarpiṣo nirgamāya vai bahistasyā ekāṃśenābhito vaṭam aṃśenaikena parito dalāni parikapayet tadatrānupadeśena jāva (ya) te na manoharam dantamūlāgrayoḥ kuṇḍau (?) guṇavedāṅgule kramāt ṣaḍbhiraṃśaiḥ pucchabhāgo vedyāḥ kūrmākṛtirbhavet pṛṣṭhabhāge'syāḥ saṃproktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ srucaḥ dvāviṃśatyādaṇḍamānamaṃśairetasya kīrtitam aṃśadvayena nikhanet paṅke mṛgapadākṛtim lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ sarvatantrānusārataḥ vidhivadvidvāniti phetkāriṇīmatam vyādhikaraṃ proktaṃ sruvaṃ dhārayate katham tanmadhye dhārayecchaṃkhamudrayā tasmātsaṅgopayenmantrī homakāle yathāvidhi saṃhatāṅgulipāṇistu vāgyato juhuyāddhaviḥ vā saṃkṣipte homakarmaṇi idānīmabhidhāsye'tra samyak ṣaṭkarmalakṣaṇam manīṣiṇaḥ vaśyaṃjanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidheyatvamudīritam dveṣajananaṃ mitho vidveṣaṇaṃ matam prāṇaharaṇaṃ māraṇaṃ samudāhṛtam proktāḥ karmādau tāḥ prapūjayet ahorātraṃ dine dine

śāntike prokto vasanto vaśyakarmaṇi prāvṛḍuccāṭane jñeyā śaranmāraṇa karmaṇi bhadramityāhu rāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥ vikaṭāsanametatsyādupaviśyotkaṭāsane karadvandvaṃ kukkuṭāsanamīritam | pārśvapādau ca pāṇibhyāṃ baddhaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ bhavet kramato jñeyāḥ padmapāśagadāhvayāḥ padmapāśādikā mudrāḥ kathyate'śani lakṣaṇam jalaṃ śāntividhau śastaṃ vaśye vahnirudīritaḥ vāyurbhūyo'gnirmāraṇe mataḥ tattatkarmavidhātavyaṃ mantriṇā niśitātmanā pāvakasyordhvaṃ gatistiryaṅnabhasvataḥ kuryāt stambhanaṃ vaśyamātmavit maruto vipakṣoccāṭanādikam proktasteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi maṇḍalam svastikopetaṃ vahnerardhendusaṃyutam tattadbhūtasamābhāni maṇḍalāni vidurbudhāḥ viyanmarutkṛṣṇo rakto'gnirviśadaṃ payaḥ proktāḥ purāteṣāṃ kulākulaparīkṣaṇe syuryantrabījāni ṣaṭkarmasu yathākramam ityete vinyāsāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasu tadvijānīyātpraśastaṃ śāntikarmaṇi vidarbha eṣu (ṣa) vijñeyo mantribhirvaśyakarmaṇi saṃstambhane śasta ityuktaṃ mantravedibhiḥ vidveṣaṇavidhāneṣu praśastamidamīritam

bhavenmantraḥ pallavo māraṇe mataḥ mantrasamproktā devatāḥ ṣaṭṣu karmasu budhejyaravisaṃyuktā śāntikarmaṇi pūjitā pauṣṭike śastā aṣṭamī navamī tathā ākarṣaṇetvamāvāsyā navamī pratipattathā caturdaśītadvadaṣṭamī mandatārakā caturdaśyaṣṭamī kṛṣṇā amāvāsyā tathaiva ca vijñeyā tithiḥ stambhanakarmaṇi riktārke mṛtyuyoge ca māraṇam gṛhadhūmaścitāṅgāro māraṇe'ṣṭaviṣāṇi ca gṛhadhūmāstrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudāhṛtam ṣaṭkarmāṇi prayuñjīta yathoktaphalasiddhaye vidhānānītyūcire sāmpradāyikāḥ dvistrirvā punarācaret kiñcidupahāsamavāpnuyāt prasiddhānaprasiddhāṃśca nīlasārasvatādikān tattatprasiddhavividhaprabandhapaṭalasthitān tripurabhairavyā vāgbhavaṃ bījamuddharet sarasvatyainamaścānte rudrasaṃkhyākṣaro manuḥ pārijāteśvarī vāṇī devatā samudīritā chando devatā vāk samīritā ṣoḍaśavarṇāḍhyaṃ vāgaiśvaryaphalapradam mantraḥ prokta ekādaśākṣaraḥ munibhiḥ prokto rudrasaṃkhyākṣaro manuḥ sārasvārthinām

trīṇi bījāni ṛṣyādyetasya pūrvavat tanucchadaṃ cānte nīlasārasvato manuḥ] phaḍantaśceduktā caikajaṭā pṛthak kathitaiva yathākramāt mantraḥ kathitaścaturakṣaraḥ tāraśaktivadhūbījānyante dīrghaṃ tanucchadam vadhūbījamaparo'sau guṇākṣaraḥ yugaṃ paścānmahāpadme samīrayet bindurbālābījamidaṃ bhavet śrīḥ samīritā mantraḥ caturvargaphalāvahaḥ devatāḥ śrīḥ samīritā pāśau vahnibīja samujjvalaḥ | mahālakṣmyāḥ samuddiṣṭastārādyaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ jagatāmādirmahālakṣmīḥ samīritā dharā dīrghā lakṣādirbhagavānmarut proktaḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥ bindudhruveśvarīyuktaṃ śrībījapuṭitaṃ bhavet lakṣmīrmahā sāmrājyadā bhavet samākhyātaṃ sevitaṃ siddhikāṃkṣibhiḥ surasaṃghena sevitā bhuvaneśvarī samuddharenmantrī trivargaphalasādhanam vāgbījapuṭitā māyā vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī matā syurdevatā bhuvaneśvarī bhagavān kṣantrī (strī) dīrghaṃtanucchadam

puruṣārthaphalapradā (ṇṭa)kī samākhyātā vidyā varṇatrayātmikā kṣeruddhā strī trivarṇeyaṃ vidyā vaśyatrikaṇṭakī mantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ naśchando nivṛnnityā ca devatā ravisaṃkhyārṇo mantrovaśyapradāyakaḥ prastāriṇī proktā devatābhīṣṭa dāyinī vidyeyaṃ dvicāntorudravarṇabhāg sammohanaśchando gāyatraṃ tripuṭeśvarī proktastrayodaśabhirakṣaraiḥ ṭhayugalaṃ manuḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ tataścānnapūrṇe svāhā dhruvādivān annapūrṇeśvarī siddhā devatā samudrīritā manurākhyātaḥ sarvavaśyapradāyakaḥ pippalādo muniśchando nivṛddhūmāvatīmanuḥ karṇabindvāḍhyo bhūyo'sau sargavān bhavet hṛdayānto'yaṃ mantro vasvakṣarātmakaḥ durgāsamīritāsadbhirduritāpannivāriṇī aṣṭākṣarī samākhyātā vidyā mahiṣamardinī durgeyaṃ vidyā vedyā daśākṣarī vahnijāyānto manureṣa daśākṣaraḥ mastrānte vahnijāyāvadhirmanuḥ devatā proktā samastasuravanditā sanetrenduḥ svapiṣisyādbhayaṃ ca me vadedbhagavatiṃ tataḥ

vanadurgākhyā sarvadurgavināśinī śaktirastraṃ vahnivadhūrbhavet śaktitritattvavāgbījaṃ tāramantrān samuddharet dvicānto'sau triśaktistāvadakṣarī chinnamastāmanurbhavet syānmāyāyugmaṃ phaḍuccaret pañcabhirādyantamadhyeṣu militaiḥ pṛthak samrāḍiha proktaśchando'syā bhairavaṃ bhavet viyattadādikendrāgnisthitaṃ vāmākṣi bindumat prathamaṃ bījaṃ kāmabījaṃ dvitīyakam pañcakūṭātmikā vidyā vedyā tripurabhairavī deśikairuktā devī tripurabhairavī candrabījādhaḥ śivabījamiti kvacit ṣaṭkūṭametatkathitaṃ bindunādayutaṃ kramāt pūrvoktabhairavīmantre kāmakūṭe parā śivām mādanaṃ bījaṃ śivamatra tridhā bhavet cādyayugmamantyaṃ visargavat ṣaṭkūṭabhairavīvarṇān saṃhārakramato likhet ḍāmareśvarabhairavyāḥ kāmaṃ hitvā sureśvari nāma bhairavī samudāhṛtā ceyamīśvarī bhṛgusargāḍhyo manustārttiyamīritam tathādiṃ ca saiva śīghraphalā bhavet tripureśānī bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥ candreśavahnivāmākṣibindunādamayaṃ bhavet

kurutārttīyaṃ vidyā vedākṣarī bhavet sarvasaubhāgyadā bhavet devatā jagadīśvarī vāgbhave devi nityakledini cālikhet vāmākṣibindunādāntān tārabījaṃ tato likhet ākhyātaṃ devatā jīvanī bhavet ṛṣyādi devī kāmeśvarī matā cavargamantyahīnaṃ tu vilikhedvahnisaṃsthitam syād bhareṇḍā devatā bhavet parāṃ vilikhya vahnyante vāsinyai nama ityapi vasiṣṭhaḥ syādgāyatraṃ chanda ucyate kathaṃ (pharaiṃ) māyā candrabījaṃ visargavat gāyatramityuktaṃ devīvajreśvarī bhavet chando'syāṃ devateritā gāyatrī chanda ucyate kāmado maṇiḥ manumālikhet proktā bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥ bhedā noktā vistarakāraṇāt bhuvaneśānībījaṃ tad vāgbhavaṃ bhavet rahitamādyādho madanākṣaram kāmabījaṃ mahodayam kevalaṃ tu viniyojya varānane purasundarī prathamāyāstu vidyāyāḥ śaktiṃ turyañca sundari

vidyāyāstārtīyaṃ suravandite lopāmudrāprabhāveṇa sākṣādbrahmasvarūpiṇī kuryādvāgbhave tu śivādyaṃ kāmabījakam syāddakṣiṇāmūrttiśchandaḥ paṃktyāhvayaṃ bhavet madhyaṃ ca haṃsayukkṣmākṣahendumat (tantre tu) trikūṭamidamuktavat] tato bālā śrīḥ parā ṣoḍaśākṣarī cāntarmukhaṃ kṛtvā vilikhettadanantaram sampuṭaṃ kuryādramākhyā parameśvarī bindunādāntamādau vyatyāsato likhet ṣoḍaśārṇeyaṃ proktā tantrāntare kramāt pūrvavadbhedā noktā vistarakāraṇāt parata īśvarīṃ yojayecchive śakrabījasthaṃ yojayedbhuvaneśvarīm raktasaptamaśakrasthaṃ māyābījaṃ samuddharet dharādharasutābījamekatrāpi niyojayet candrasaṃsthamākāśaṃ raktasaṃsthitam paradevatā sarvarājavaśaṃ paścāt karisarvapadaṃ tataḥ sarvaduṣṭamṛgavaśaṃ kari sarvabhṛgustvara jāyāgneraṣṭāśītyakṣaro manuḥ dīrghaṃtanucchadaṃ kālī manuḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ dvedhā tadante ca phaḍuccaret tataḥ kūrcaṃ phaḍantā tryakṣarī bhavet nādavindusamāyuktāvevaṃ krodhadvayaṃ punaḥ

ucchiṣṭapadamābhāṣya vadeccāṇḍālinītyapi tataṣṭānto guṇaśaḥ sargabinduvā (mā) n varṇaiḥ sarvābhīṣṭakaro bhavet mahāśvetāmanurasau samproktaścaturakṣaraḥ syānmuniśchando nivṛdvighno'sya devatā hṛdantorccāvidhauhomehi (dvi) cā (ṭhā) ntikaḥ gaṇapatiṃ paścādvarānte varadaṃ padam aṣṭāviṃśatyakṣaro'yaṃ tārādyo manurīritaḥ mahākālī dhruvādikā kūrcayugaṃ māyāyugaṃ syāddakṣiṇe padam dviṭhaṃ kālīmanurdvāviṃśadakṣaraḥ māntaśca lāntonāntastathaiva ca ebhiraṣṭākṣarairmantraṃ śoṇapadmamiva smaret chando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca mahāmāyā manorbhavet (ttvāṃ) tārayormadhye vārāhītyaparā bhavet bhuvaneśīti saṃproktā bhavānyāstryakṣaro manuḥ sargayogātparo bhavet mahāgaṇapatiḥ prokto devatā devavanditā paścād varadānte vadet punaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaromantro bhajatāṃ surapādapaḥ vighneśvaraḥ prokto bhajatāṃ sarvakāmadaḥ ṅe'ntamagnivadhūḥ prokto mantro'yaṃdvādaśākṣaraḥ tantre nāmnāśaktigaṇādhipaḥ pūrvamuktāḥ syurasya mantrasya vai kramāt hṛnmantraḥ svabījādyo daśākṣaraḥ

vighno devatāsya udīritā tārādihṛdayānto'yaṃ herambamanurīritaḥ saptavarṇaḥ svabrahmaṇyātmako manuḥ durgāmekārāḍhyāṃ samuddharet saṃproktaḥ suśrīvādirapi kramāt ṅentamucchiṣṭaśabdāḍhyaṃ mahātmānaṃ tathā vadet ṅentamathocchiṣṭa svāhāṣṭāviṃśadarṇavān māyānte namaścāṣṭākṣaro bhavet bhṛguśchandaḥ paṃktiḥ somo'sya devatā marut śeṣaḥ sanetro'tristyapaścimaḥ savitābhīṣṭasiddhidaḥ bhṛgurbhānostryakṣaromanurīritaḥ tadādiḥ sargasaṃyutaḥ girijāpatiḥ sādhayāgnipriyā tataḥ ṛṣirbhṛgurbhavecchando gāyatrī devatānalaḥ lohitākṣapadaṃ dehi me dadāpaya ṭhadvayam proktā manorasya manīṣibhiḥ ṛṣyādyāḥ prāgvadevāsya devatā pāvako mahān sohaṃ svāhāṣṭavarṇavān sākṣātparaṃ jyotiḥ svarūpadhṛk mantroyaṃ prokto vasvakṣarātmakaḥ devī gāyatrī devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥ tantre mantro'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ prokto vāsudevo manīṣibhiḥ

vāsudevāya hṛdantaḥ praṇavādikaḥ devatā dadhivāmanaḥ sarvavāgīśvaretyante pravadedīśvaretyatha mantrastārādirīritaḥ devatā syāddhayagrīvo vāgaiśvaryapradāyakaḥ ṣaḍakṣaro'yamādiṣṭaḥ bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥ samākhyāto rāmo rākṣasamardanaḥ manurasau bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥ mantrastantravidbhirudīritaḥ svāhānto'ṅgaphaḍantaśca namo'ntaśca ṣaḍarṇavān rāmaśabdaścaturthyanto namaḥ pañcākṣaro manuḥ manurasau kathitaṃ tantravedibhiḥ rāmabhadrapade'pyevamudito'ṣṭākṣro manuḥ candrabhadrāntaṃ sacaturthaṃ navākṣaram noktā vistarakāraṇāt syātpataye tadanantaram vahnijāyāvadhirmantraḥ syāttrayastriṃśadakṣaraḥ devatādivarāho'sya mantrasya kathito budhaiḥ dvandvaṃ dviṭhānto'yaṃ dhruvādikaḥ proktaśchando nivṛdudāhṛtam devatā sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtirdharaṇīmatā padamābhāṣya sarvatomukhamīrayet namāmyahamayaṃ prokto mantrarājaḥ suradrumaḥ narasiṃho'sya surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ bindunādalasanmūrdhā bījaṃ naraharerviduḥ

paścāddīptadaṃṣṭrāyatatparam sarvabhūtavināśānte la(na) kāro bindumān marut saptaṣaṣṭyakṣaraiḥ prokto jvālāmālī mahāmanuḥ narahareḥ kathitaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ narasiṃho'sya mantrasya samudīritaḥ kavacāstrānto mantraḥ saptākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ munibhiḥ proktaścakrarūpī hariḥ svayam gopījanapadasyānte vallabhāya dviṭhāvadhiḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ kaṃsaniṣūdanaḥ manobhuvaḥ proktaṃ jagattritayamohanam sākṣāddevatā makaradhvajaḥ mukundaścarṣipūrvakaḥ nama ityaparomanuḥ siddhayaḥ sarvāḥ syurjapādyairihāmunā kṛṣṇarūpanamodvandvamannādhipataye namaḥ nārado'nuṣṭubannādhipatayo'syarṣipūrvakāḥ ṛṣyādyā brahma-gāyatrī-grahaghnaharayaḥ kramāt viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave chando'nuṣṭubdevatāsya śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥ varmāstraśirāṃsyaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ devakīputramityuktvānnṛtyaśabdataḥ kāliyamardanaḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ kṛṣṇastu devatā ramā gopījanavallabha ṅeśiraḥ

aṣṭādaśārṇavatsarvamaṅgarṣyādikamūhayet ravyarṇobrahmagāyatrīkṛṣṇarṣyādiranukramāt evādau syāccecchaktiramānvitaḥ manuvarṇānāmaṅgarṣyādi daśārṇavat ṛṣyādyaṣṭādaśārṇoktaṃ manorasya yathākramāt nandānte vapuṣe'styagnimāyānto daśavarṇakaḥ nandaputrapadaṃ ṅentaṃ śyāmalāṅgapadaṃ tathā ṛṣiśchandaścoṣṇiganuṣṭubhau ṣoḍaśārṇo'yaṃ rukmiṇīvallabhāhvayaḥ chando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca rukmiṇīvallabho hariḥ daṇḍānte bālarūpeti meghaśyāmapadaṃ tataḥ ca nī (lī) lādaṇḍaharirmataḥ māṃsayugantāya śiraḥ saptākṣaro manuḥ uṣṇigdevatā ca govallabha udīritaḥ dvandvaṃ dvādaśārṇo'yamīritaḥ śārṅgī cakrī dakṣiṇakarṇayuk ṛṣirbrahmāsya gāyatrī chandaḥ kṛṣṇastu devatā śrīṃ siddha gopālako manuḥ dvayakṣaraḥ kāmapūrvastryarṇaḥ sa eva cet vakṣyate pañcavarṇaḥ syātkṛṣṇāya nama ityapi gopālāyāgnijāyāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣara udāhṛtaḥ namo'nto'nyaḥ kṛṣṇagovindakaḥ punaḥ śrīśaktimārāḥ kṛṣṇāya māraḥ saptākṣaro'paraḥ dadhibhakṣaṇaṅevahnijāyamiraparoṣṭakaḥ mūlamantraśca navārṇaḥ smarasaṃpuṭaḥ

gāyatrī devatā kṛṣṇa īritaḥ māṃsādho raktaṃ cedaparo manuḥ śikhivāmākṣiśaśikhaṇḍavibhūṣitāḥ krīḍāsaktapraśabdānte vadenmucetase kṛṣṇapadaṃ cekṣukārmukānte daśākṣaraḥ kramotkramavaśād dvipañcāśallipirmanuḥ ṛṣiśchando virāḍbhavet sākṣilānto latānvito marut vāmadevo ṛṣiśchandaḥ paṃktirīśo'sya devatā ṛṣiśchandaḥ purā prokto devatā syādumāpatiḥ paṃktirdevaḥ sadāśivaḥ vasuvarṇo manurmataḥ nigaditomantro mṛtyuñjayātmakaḥ devatāsya samīritaḥ vaṭamūlapadasyānte padaṃpaścānnivāsine mantraḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrttināmāsya devatā śambhurīritaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrttiṃ mahyaṃ medhāmudīrayet dakṣiṇāmūrttirākhyāto vedavyākhyānatatparaḥ bahnibījasthā dīrghā śāntīndubhūṣitā nīlakaṇṭhātmakaḥ prokto viṣadvayaharaḥ paraḥ khyātaṃ bījaṃ sarvasamṛddhidam prokto devatā jagatāṃ patiḥ tumbarūbījantadyena sidhyanti sādhakāḥ ghoraghorataretyante tanurūpapadaṃ tataḥ

ramadvandvaṃ tato bandhayugaṃ punaḥ ekapañcāśadarṇo'yamaghorāstramahāmanuḥ saṃdiṣṭo devatāmantravittamaiḥ karṇayuto varmāstrāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ vasuvarṇo'yaṃ kṣetrapālasya kīrtitaḥ śaktiruddho mahāmanuḥ phaḍantaścaṇḍamantro'yaṃ trivarṇāntaḥ samīritaḥ devatā prokto deśikaistantrakovidaiḥ dīrghasaṃyuktaścānte syāddvicaturthayoḥ kukkuṭeśvaramantro'yamuktaḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ mahābhairavamantro'yamuḍḍīśaḥ siddhisādhanam bahavo noste'lasairaparigrahāt ca maheśānyā daurgāścaiva daśāpare gaṇeśasya somasyaikamathakramāt catvāriṃśattathā'ṣṭau ca gopālamanavaḥ kramāt śambhoḥ pañcadaśeritāḥ sapariṣkāramālokya tathā sārasamuccayam pūjāpradīpaṃ ca puraścaraṇa candrikām mantrā * * * śrīrāmārcanacandrikām sanatkumārasya nāradīyaṃ catuḥśatīm vaiṣṇavīṃ tadvattattvasāgara saṃhitām śrībhuvanaiśvaryāḥ nayasiddhāntamādarāt hayagrīvamataṃ tadvattathā vijñānabhāratam (bhairavam) gu * * * ñca tantrarājaṃ ca tathā vai piṅgalāmatam siddhāntaṃ sāraśrīsaṃhitāṃ kramāt

vasiṣṭhasaṃhitāṃ gārgya-saṃhitāṃ bhairavaṃ tathā granthaṃ pratiṣṭhāsāra saṃgraham viṣṇubrahmarudrādiyāmalam pārvatīharasaṃvādaṃ vārāhītantramādarāt phetkāriṇītantraṃ subhagodayamādarāt tadvatsiddhāntaṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ vividhaṃ tadvat smṛtiśāstrāṇi bhāratam puraścaryādikarmaṇaḥ vallabhā mama kaumudī kiṃ ca jīvanaṃ mama kaumudī grāhyaṁ bālādapi subhāṣitam pratipāditāya mahase tasmai parasmainamaḥ devanātha vibudhena satāṃ mude'stu devanātho jagaddhitām
